author: Palukurty Deva Vara Prasad
preamble: In the Gospels according to  Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, the life history of Jesus Christ was narrated as a fulfillment of God's promise to his people (Jews) as well as  to the people in the whole world, to provide salvation. The birth of Jesus as the only son of God, the miracles and healings done by him, his teachings and preachings, and prayers to God, his resurrection and his appearances before disciples and many others, are all narrated in the Gospels.

He saw the miseries of some people, who he met and who met him. He pitied them and healed, and in the process he has done many miracles. Though  innumerable healings are done, a few miracles and healings were described in the Bible with certain details. All of them are listed and tried to present before the viewers/readers, revealing the lessons for us.

Water turned into wine, catch abundant fish by Peter and others,  calming a storm, raising dead persons like daughter of Jairus, Lazarus and others, feeding more than 5000 and 4000 people in two occasions, his transfiguration before disciples and appearances  to the disciples after resurrection etc., are miracles, while healing sickness of several diseases, giving sight to blind, hearing ability to the deaf and talking capacity to deaf and dumb persons, healing from the suffering of devil etc, were all dealt separately to the extent possible.

miracles.title: Changing water into wine
scripture: There was a wedding in the town of Cana in Galilee.  The Mother of Jesus was there, and  Jesus and his Disciples had also been invited for the wedding. When the wine had given out, Jesus' mother said to him, “they have no wine left.'' Jesus replied “You must not tell me what to do, my time has not yet come”. Jesus' mother told the servants, “Do whatever he tells you”. The Jews have rules about ritual washing, and for this purpose six stone water jars were there, each one large enough to hold about a hundred liters.

Jesus said to the servants, “fill these jars with water”. They filled those jars with water to the brim. Jesus told them, “now draw some water out, and take it to the man in-charge of the feast”. They took him the water, which now turned into wine, and he tasted it. The man in- charge of the feast called on and praised the bridegroom. This is the first miracle that Jesus Christ did.
meditation: Mother of Jesus knows that since Jesus is the Son of God he can do a miracle. She told the servants to follow the instructions of Jesus and they waited for the instructions. Jesus told his mother that his time has not yet come. Since his purpose was, for the salvation of souls, he said indirectly that his time for his purpose has not yet come.

When the servants were waiting for his instructions, he pitied the waiting servants, and though his time had not come, he did the miracle. Jesus is  a graceful person  and he answers to those waiting on him. We need to keep our hope and faith in Jesus, waiting for his guidance.
This was told as the first miracle of Jesus.  He fulfilled his mother's wish in priority and also aimed to strengthen the faith of his disciples.

The problem, that the wine went out of stock, is that of the marriage organizers. However the mother of Jesus wanted to help in their anguish and interfered. As a fellow, we are supposed to help others, like our family member, neighbor, friend, colleague or one of our church congregations and as a fellow citizen. When anybody needs our help or support, we are supposed to help them, at free will. God likes and blesses such helping people and sees its fulfillment.

Jesus did not touch the stone jars filled with water. He did not even  approach the water jars. Jesus asked the workers to take the water to the person in-charge of the function. The workers knew what had happened, but did not tell him about the miracle. The faithful workers who waited for his instructions had the great opportunity to witness the first miracle.

In the old testament, there was a widow of a God-fearing  prophet, having two sons. When she could not repay the dues to the lenders, they wanted to take her two sons as slaves. She approached and prayed to the prophet Elisha, to save her.

Elisha  asked her what else she had in her house. In the circumstances of acute famine, by human weakness, we rush to say that  there is nothing with us.  But she honestly said to the prophet Elisha that she  had a small amount of oil  in a small pot. Elisha instructed her to fill all the empty vessels in the house and bring empty vessels of neighbors also.

When the filling of all the vessels was completed, the blessing stopped. (See 2 kings 4:2-7).   God's blessing to the honest people not only fulfills the needs, but also provides overwhelming grace. She could overcome the famine in that country.
Believing, waiting, obeying His commandments in faith, and unconditionally  helping those in need, are  some of the lessons we can learn by this miracle.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious God, we thank you for the lessons we learn from this miracle, such as keeping faith in you, waiting for your guidance and following your commandments, and extending our unconditional helping hand to those in need. Give us grace to set right our lives. We pray in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,  Amen.

miracles.title: Abundant catch of fish by Peter and others
scripture: After finishing his teachings to the crowd from the boat, Jesus said, “push the boat out further to deep water, and you and your partners, let down your nets for a catch”. Simon answered that “Master, we worked hard all night long and caught nothing, but as you say, I will let down the nets”.  They let them down and caught such a large number of fish that the nets were about to break. So they motioned to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. They came and filled both boats so full of fish that the boats were about to  sink.

When Simon Peter saw what had happened, he fell on his knees before Jesus and said “Go away from me Lord, I am a sinful man”. He and the others with him were all amazed at the large number of fish they had caught. The same was true of Simon’s partners, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. Jesus said to Simon, “Don't be afraid, from now on you will be catching men”. They pulled up the boats on the beach, left everything and followed Jesus.

Though Simon could not catch anything on the previous night, he let his boat  for the purpose of Jesus and by following his direction he could catch abundant fish.  His contribution of letting his boat for God's purpose is very small and he was blessed abundantly. He and his friends feared and were astonished at the miracle. As Peter could see the Holiness of Jesus, he reached and fell before Jesus and prayed to leave him since he was a sinner.
meditation: Malachi 3:10 says, “Bring the full amount of your tithes to the temple so that there will be plenty of food there. Put me to the test and you will see that I will open the windows of heaven and pour out on you, in abundance, all kinds of good things”.
Though there was no direction, the sea fish came voluntarily as  a catch at the right side of the boat, when Jesus directed Peter to let down the nets on the right side of the boat. It is a miracle.
This miracle happened when Peter obeyed the direction of Jesus,  despite  his doubts on account of his human expertise in fishing.
After receiving the abundant blessing, the son of Simon went in front of Jesus in awe and fear. Realizing that he was sinful and unworthy of Jesus' presence, he prayed to Jesus to  leave him.

When Jesus said that I will make you fisherer for men. Peter, Jakob and John (sons of Zebedee)  left all their fish and everything (ie., earthly earnings) and followed Jesus. They had a blessed life in Jesus.
miracles.prayer: Our loving Father, Simon, Jakob and John, left everything and followed you after physically looking at the miracle, how the creation obeyed you on a command. Strengthen us in our faith and in obeying your command. We pray in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a man suffering from evil spirits
scripture: Jesus and his disciples came to the town of Capernaum. And on the next Sabbath, Jesus went to the synagogue and began to teach. The people heard him are amazed at the way he taught, for he was not like the teachers of the Law, instead, he taught with authority.  Just then, a man with an evil spirit in him, came to the synagogue and screamed, “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Are you here to destroy us? I know who you are - You are God's Holy messenger”.

Jesus ordered the spirit, ”Be quiet and come out of the man”. The evil spirit shook the man hard, gave a loud scream, and came out of him. The people were all so amazed that they started saying one another, “What is this?'' “Is it some kind of new teaching? This man has authority to give orders to the evil spirits, and they obey him.”
meditation: It is evident from the above that every spirit, whether a Holy spirit or an evil spirit, can know the status of the other spirit. But the Holy Spirit only can order the evil spirit. Jesus, Son of God, having the Holy spirit, and also the people having Holy spirit, can command the evil spirits to go out.  This is possible to those having the Holy spirit and those who pleased God.

Evil spirit loudly announced Jesus as Holy and Son of God. Jesus and those having the Holy spirit can  condemn the evil spirits. This was widespread at the synagogue  where people gathered to worship God. This popularization was one out of fear as well as praise. The beneficiary is bound to praise God, by worship  and by following His commands in true spirit.

Luke 9:55 says “don't you know what kind of spirit you belong to, for the son of man did not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them”.  Mathew 10:28 says “Do not be afraid of  those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul, rather be afraid of God, who can destroy both body and soul in hell”.

Evil spirits know these things, but man is not able to identify and hear the spiritual calling from his heart. God wishes our body and spirit as His Home. Our body and spirits are His gifts. We can please God and live to get eligibility by His grace provided we keep out our  body and spirit from evil, and seek His protection.
miracles.prayer: Our Holy God, you gave us a body and spirit as a gift. Help us to maintain our body without sin,  and the spirit as Holy. We pray in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a dreaded skin diseased person by touching him
scripture: A man suffering from a dreaded skin disease came to Jesus, knelt down,  and begged him for help. “If you want to”, he said, “you can clean me”. Jesus was filled with pity, and stretched out his hand and touched him, “I do want to” Jesus answered, “Be clean”. At once the disease left the man,  and he was clean.

Then Jesus spoke sternly to him, and sent him away at once, “Listen, don't tell anyone about this, but go straight to the priest and tell him to examine you, and then in order to prove every one that you are cured, offer the sacrifice that Moses ordered”. But the man went away and began to  spread the news everywhere.
meditation: Though Jesus can cure such a deadly disease by a simple word, Jesus touched him with love and pity.   Persons considered as gods in the world,  do not like to touch a person suffering from a deadly skin disease. Jesus did it, because he loved people and pitied them. Jesus showed himself as a model to the world by touching a dreadly diseased person.

Faith in humans is strengthened by witnesses. Spreading the news of his cure everywhere increases faith on Jesus. By witnessing, the faith was strengthened at his family circles, synagogues and temples, between the believers and in public. Faith increases by hearing witnesses and it was one of the commandments of God. Witness exalts the glory of God.

Dreaded skin disease is leprosy which is really an unbearable  disease. People suffering with that skin disease are kept aloof and  outside the residential areas. They are not allowed to move in public places. Even after healing, if a skin diseased person wants to move in public, they have to show themselves that they are out of that disease. They are required to get a clearance from the temple priest. After clearance only they are allowed to move in common residential areas and to enter a temple and make their offers as per the laws of Moses.

In olden days, as per the revelation given by God, Moses has given a set of rules for offerings, - when the people are healed and also when people are blessed by God.  This amount is called Tieth, ie., tenth portion of their income, which is meant for use in temples and for the livelihood of priests, since they are not supposed to go for any other work for their daily bread.  This procedure of Tieth was there  even prior to Abraham.

When Jesus saw a poor widow dropping in two little coins worth about a penny in the offering box, Jesus said that “this poor widow put more in the offering box than all the others” stating “she gave all she had to live on”. (See Mark 12:44). She gave all she had to live on, but not limited to a tenth portion of her income. What quantum  we offered is not important but how heartfully we made the offer is very important. God knows our attitudes and our heart and nothing is invisible to God.

We are bound to announce our witness, make praise and also give our offerings when we are blessed or healed as a mark of sacrifice or gratitude. Witness strengthens our faith and offering is a manifestation of expressing our faith and gratitude towards God.
“Faith without action is dead”  said James 2:26.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, You have cleaned man with dreaded skin disease, when he prayed. Clean us  from our unholy acts and arrogant behavior and make us stand as a witness to you. We pray for help in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

miracles.title: Calming down a storm
scripture: Jesus got into a boat, and his disciples went with him.  Suddenly a fierce storm hit the lake and the boat was in danger of sinking. But Jesus was asleep in the boat.  The disciples went to him and woke him up - “save us Lord” they said, “we are about to die”.   “Why are you so frightened,” Jesus answered, ‘how little faith you have‘. Then he got up and ordered the winds and the waves to stop,  and there was a great calm. Everyone was amazed. What kind of man is this?”, they said, “even the winds and the waves obey him”.

Nature never fails to obey and act on its duty to suit the laws entrusted by God to it. The water and wind  follow its laws. Scientists found that water is a combination of two gasses. There are many varieties of gasses in nature. Gasses change their properties at different situations and at  different heats when they meet at their basic structures, and also change their properties, weights, volumes and moving directions etc.
meditation: God is the creator who allowed them to change their basic structures at different conditions. At God’s Will, the atoms and molecules of gasses, liquids and solids perform their set duties. “The winds blow south, the winds blow north - round and round and back again” says Eccleciastes 1:6.
It is not the winds on earth alone, the entire Universe has  its moving schedule and it moves round and round in its way. This was written more than 1000 years before Christ  in the Bible.

Nature never fails to express its reactions as per the properties entrusted to it  by God. Nature cannot keep quiet in performing its properties, simply because the Son of God is there in the boat. But nature surely follows and obeyed when God commands it.

Disciples need not fear the storm, since they are aware that they are following the Son of God and Savior. At that time their faith went weak and they feared. They should have been stable in full faith. As followers of the Son of God, they need not fear anybody or any situation. We should have full faith as God is with us. “ Don't be afraid and be bold” is the word of Jesus, which we have to keep in mind always.

There are many instances in the old testament, such as walking in dry land in the midst of sea by Isralites when water stagnated as  wall at both sides, and rain of manna as food to them. When Shadrach, Meshek and Abednego were thrown into fire,  nature obeyed the orders of God. Now nature obeyed the  orders of the Son of God, Jesus. The disciples  could see the wonderful miracle.
miracles.prayer: We praise you God, the entire Creator of the universe,  for its maintenance. Instead of depending on you,  we keep on frequently failing, in spite of your sayings “not to be afraid and to be bold’. Strengthen us from that weakness. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a man with a paralyzed hand on a Sabbath day
scripture: “Jesus went back to the synagogue, where there was a man who had a paralyzed hand. Some people were there who wanted to accuse Jesus of doing anything wrong.  So they watched him closely to see whether he would heal the man on the Sabbath day. Jesus said to them, ‘come up here to the front’.
meditation: Then he asked the people, ”what does our law allow us to do on the Sabbath day? To help or to harm? To save a man's life or to destroy it?” But they did not say a thing.  Jesus was angry as he looked around at them, but at the same time  he felt sorry for them, because they were so stubborn and wrong. Then he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand”. He stretched out, and it became well again. Jesus healed that man by his word only without even touching him.

Pharisees wanted to find a fault with Jesus and asked whether it is right to heal a man on a Sabbath day.  Jesus answered, ‘What if one of you has a sheep and it falls into a deep hole on the Sabbath day. Will he not take hold of it and lift it out? And  a man is worth more than a sheep. So then, our law does allow us to help on the Sabbath day”

Jesus knew the thoughts of people and therefore he questioned the Pharisees and others who were there to find fault with him stating “whether to help or to harm on a Sabbath day”. Thus he showed transparency before doing healing, so that the fault finding people could not find a fault with Jesus.
This is an act of healing. Jesus preached that the Laws, time and occasions should not come in the way of helping people, and in saving lives.

Jesus came to the synagogue to explain and elaborate  people on the Laws of God.  He knows that the Pharisees are following him everywhere to find a fault in Him. He showed us as a transparent model of this healing, so that we have to rightly face any troubles and criticisms in  doing good things.
miracles.prayer: Father, you know our mindset and our thoughts.  You taught us your laws at that time and customs do not come in our way for helping people in need and in saving lives. Lead us to live such a transparent life and to help people. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a man having demons called “Mob”
scripture: When Jesus came to the territory of Gadara on the other side of the lake, he was met by a man who came out of the burial caves there. He had demons in him and was so fierce that no one  dared to travel on that road. He screamed “What do you want with us? You, Son of God? Have you come to punish us before the right time?”

Not far away, there was a large herd of pigs feeding. So the demons begged Jesus “if you are going to drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs”.  “Go” Jesus told them: so they left and went off into the pigs. The whole herd  rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake and drowned.

The men who were taking care of the pigs ran away and went into the town, where they told the whole story and what had happened to the man with the demons. Everyone from the town went out to meet Jesus: and when they found him, they begged him to leave their territory.
meditation: The man from whom the Demons had gone out begged Jesus, “Let me go with you”. But Jesus sent him away saying, “Go back home and tell what God had done for you”. The man went through the town, telling what Jesus had done for him.

Evil spirits understood that Jesus came to destroy them. Evil spirits also understood that Jesus is the Son of God. They also know that they are bound to be  destroyed at the appropriate time. Therefore they asked Jesus for permission to enter into the pigs. On permission they left the man called “Mob” and entered into those pigs.

Knowing the fact that the devil left the man and entered into the pigs who jumped in water and died, the people in the town prayed to Jesus to leave their town and area. Those people were concerned about their property they lost, but they are not happy about the healing.

The person  suffering from the devil got healed. It is natural that the healed person likes to follow Jesus and enjoy the presence of Jesus.  But Jesus desired that the healed person should be a witness for him. Healed person should be a witness for his whole life,  firstly at his home and also in his town area.
miracles.prayer: Our Holy God, evil spirits understood that they can not face Holiness. Help us to leave unholy spirits in us and to fill with the Holy Spirit and to enjoy  your presence. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a paralyzed man who was put down from the roof of a house
scripture: One day when Jesus was preaching in a crowded house, some people brought to him a paralyzed man lying on a bed. Because of the crowd, they could not get the man near Jesus. So they made a hole at the roof of that house,  right above the place where Jesus was sitting.

When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the paralyzed man, ‘Have courage, my son,  Your sins are forgiven’. Then the teachers of the law said to themselves, ‘this man is speaking blasphemy’. Jesus perceived what they were thinking, so he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things? Is it easier to say ‘Your sins are forgiven’ or to say ‘Get up and walk”.

I will prove to you then, that the Son of  Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. Jesus said to the paralyzed man, ‘Getup, pick up your bed and go home’. The man got up and went home. When the people saw it, they were afraid, and praised God for giving such an authority to men''.
meditation: The faith of the friends of the paralyzed man to put the sick man in front of Jesus into the house, after opening the roof tiles, is great. No owner of a house  allows to remove roof tiles of his house by  others. Courage and attitude  of the friends is great and plausible. It is a courageous and praise worthy act of faith.

For some people who want to find fault with Jesus, the courageous act of the friends may look like madness. Jesus found the sick person as a consequence of his sin. Jesus pardoned his sins and healed sickness.

Jesus found the sickness as a consequence of his sin. Therefore Jesus firstly forgiven the sins of that person and then healed. The preachers of Law don't like to recognise Jesus as the Son of God. They questioned the authority of Jesus to forgive the sins of men, because they feel that only God has the authority to forgive sins, and thus Jesus is speaking blasphemy.
Jesus understood their doubt and clarified that the Son of God has authority to forgive sins. He then asked the paralyzed man to get up and go home.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, We understood that sickness is one of the consequences of our sin, and that when we realize our sins and pray for forgiveness, we get forgiveness if we forgive our neighbor. Lead us to understand and set right our lives. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Life to the dead daughter of Jairus (an official)
scripture: Jairus, an official of the local synagogue, arrived, and when he saw Jesus, he threw himself down at his feet and begged him earnestly, “my little daughter is very ill,  please come and place your hands on her, so that she will get well and  live”. Then Jesus started off with him, so many people were going along with Jesus that they were crowding him from every side.

There was a woman suffering from severe bleeding for 12 years. She touched the clothes of Jesus and got healed. Jesus stopped and let her witness her healing. At that time some messengers came from the  house of Jairus and told him “your daughter has died, why bother the teacher any longer”. But Jesus told Jairus, “don't be afraid, but only believe”. Jesus and his disciples went to the house of Jairus.

When they arrived at the house, he saw confusion and heard all the loud crying and wailing. Jesus went in and said to them  not to make noise and confusion and make room to get in. He said to them, why are you crying? The child is not dead  --  she is only sleeping. They laughed at them, so he put them all out, took the father, mother and disciples and went into the room. He took the child by hand and said “I tell you to get up”. She got up at once and started to walk around. This message was spread throughout the town.
meditation: It is a miracle to raise a dead person to life. Jairus prayed to Jesus to place his hand on his daughter, so that she could live. When Jesus said that she did not die but was sleeping, the unbelieving people there laughed at Jesus. Jairus believed in Jesus. But the unbelieving people started laughing at Jesus. Believers should take care of  themselves from the unbelievers in such circumstances.

Satan uses such unbelievers to disturb the believers. When there is a little bit of delay in proceeding to the house of Jairus on account of another healing and when Jairus’s servants brought the news that his daughter was dead, the faith of Jairus should have been shattered.

Jesus interfered personally by bringing out the witness of a bleeding lady to light, and asked, “not to fear but to believe'' and strengthened him.  “My sheep listen to my voice and no one can snatch them away from me” says Jesus in John 10:27-29. He will not leave or abandon those who believe and stay with him.

Though Jairus was told by his servants that his daughter was dead, He believed in Jesus and stayed in his faith. It is a lesson for us to stay in Jesus even in conditions beyond our control.  God's word and prayer are the main weapons, to overcome such disturbances. If we pray, God provides strength to his believers.

It was written that Jesus sent out the people crying and stirring at the house of Jairus. When God's work of healing is about to take place, and when the believers are waiting for the Holy Spirit to work, Jesus desires that the place should be Holy and peaceful, without shouts and disturbances of cries.

The disturbances faced by Job in the old testament, are not  ordinary.  His wife  instigated Job to scold God and get rid of all his disturbances. Job's fear and passion for God made him get double fold of his earlier grace and honor from God.
miracles.prayer: Thank you Lord for the promise made to us stating “I will not leave you nor forsake you”. Give us knowledge and peace to  eagerly and positively seek for your solutions, in case of our disturbances in life. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a lady suffering blood bleeding disease for 12 years
scripture: A woman who suffered from severe blood bleeding disease for twelve years, heard about  Jesus. She had spent all her money for treatment by many Doctors. Instead of getting better, she got worse all the time. She came in the crowd behind Jesus  and touched  the edge of his cloak. She said to herself “If I only touch his cloak, I will get well”. She had the feeling inside herself that she was healed of her trouble, instantly.
meditation: Jesus turned around and asked “Who touched my clothes”. His disciples answered “You see how the people are crowding you, why do you ask “who touched you?”. The woman realized what had happened and came trembling with fear, knelt at his feet and told him the entire truth. Jesus saw her and said, “Courage my daughter, your faith has made you well”. The woman became well.

She believed that she would get healed if she touched the cloth (clock) of Jesus. Jesus questioned her to let everybody know her witness. Jesus and his disciples and everybody knows that all are somehow or other touching Jesus. Jesus therefore felt that  the faith in her has to be known to everybody. Nothing is invisible to Jesus.

When questioned by Jesus specifically, she feared. She knows that the public will not allow a  lady suffering from a blood bleeding disease to openly move  in public. Therefore she trembled and feared, Jesus said to her  to get healed and have peace. Witnessing by the healed, is a gratitude and  a praise to God. Jesus made her witness instantly known to the public through her only.

She heard about Jesus and his healings. She believed that she would get healed, even if she touches his clock (cloth). She would not get healed if she simply believed and kept quiet. She attempted to touch the cloth of Jesus in spite of the huge crowd around Jesus. “Faith develops on hearing” is the word in the bible. There is no use in simply believing. Faith works if it is put to practice. It is a lesson for us.
miracles.prayer: Gracious Father, Thank you for teaching us to act according to faith instead of remaining as simple listeners and believers of you. Lead us with that knowledge and faith to get peace in our lives. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Giving life to the son of a widow after his death
scripture: Jesus went to a town called Nain, accompanied by disciples and a large crowd. Just as he arrived at the gate of the town, a funeral procession was coming out.  The dead man was the only son of a woman, who was a widow, and a large crowd from the town was with her.

When the Lord saw her, his heart was filled with pity on her, and he said to her, “Don’t cry”. Then he walked over and touched the coffin, and the men carrying it stopped. Jesus said, “Young man, get up, I tell you”.
meditation: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother. They are all filled with fear and praise to God. “A great prophet has appeared among us”, they said, “God has come to serve his people”. This news about Jesus went throughout all the country and the surrounding territory.

It is a miracle to let live a dead body being carried out  to the outskirts of the town for a funeral.  It is purely an act of pity. It was not written that the mother of the dead person prayed to Jesus to let her son live. Though she was a widow, many of the people are with her to console on the death of her son. Since she got compassion from many of the people, she could get compassion from God also. We should recollect the word in Luke chapter 2:52, “Jesus grew both in body and in wisdom, gaining favor with God and men”.
People in their thoughts and actions (works) are supposed to thrive in the favor of God as well as people around our Society.
When Jesus saw the situation, Jesus also pitied her and allowed her dead son to live. Some people felt that Jesus was a prophet and that they had seen God. God is glorified.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, Thank you for teaching us that we are supposed to thrive in this world gaining favor of God as well as the people around in our society. Give us a mind to love our neighbor and to live in harmony with love in our society. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Giving vision to two blind persons
scripture: When Jesus left the place of Jairus, the Jewish Official, and walked along,  two blind men started following him. “Take pity on us, Son of David”, they shouted. When Jesus went indoors,  the two blind men came to him, and he asked them, “Do you believe that I can heal you?”. “Yes sir”, they answered.

Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Let it happen then, just as you believe” and their sight was restored. Jesus spoke sternly to them, “Don't tell this to anyone”. But they left and spread the news all over that part of the country.
meditation: These blind persons cannot see Jesus with their own eyes. They believed in Jesus based on what they heard about Jesus. Jesus made them express their faith through their mouth. They expressed this because  they heard about Jesus that he was the Son of David, Lord and Messiah. Their faith was strengthened. They could see now and they glorified God.

These two blind persons were blessed because they got their vision and saw the world.  As said in Romans 10:17, ”faith comes from hearing the message, and the message comes through preaching Christ”. They are better than many who cannot see and understand, though having eyes and their sight. Hearing a message on Jesus develops faith, is a lesson for us.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, Thank you for the teaching that ‘faith comes from hearing the message and the message comes through preaching Christ. Two blind persons are blessed, because of the message on Christ and on expressing their faith. We pray to let our faith be fruitful in our lives. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing from devil, speech to a dumb person
scripture: Some people brought Jesus, a man who could not talk because he had a demon. But as soon as the demon was driven out, the man started talking, and everyone was amazed. “We have never seen anything like this in Israel, “ they exclaimed”. But the Pharisees said, “it is the chief of the demons who gives him the power to drive out demons”.

As per this miracle, we can see that  evil spirit is one of the causes for dumbness. People were astonished when they saw the dumb person speaking in public,  after the evil spirit left that person. People wondered  that they had never seen such a miracle earlier. But the Pharisees started saying that Jesus removed the evil spirit with the help of the Head of Evil Spirits, because they did not like to see and believe Jesus as the Son of God.
meditation: These Pharisees believed that there was a head of evil spirits, but they did not believe Jesus. Pharisees did not accept Jesus as son of God, in spite of physically looking at the miracles he had done in their presence and on his righteousness and Holiness.

It was written in 2 Corinthians 4:4 that “They do not believe because their minds have been kept in the dark by the evil god of this world.  He keeps them from seeing the light shining on them,  the light that comes from the Good News  about the glory of Christ who is the exact likeness of God”. It is because of the darkness for the unbelievers, they could not see the light of Jesus, and they started saying that the miracle was done under the help of the Head of evil spirits.

Some of the present day unbelievers started saying that Jesus had his education on Buddhism at the well known Universities in India, and that he lived till his old age, and that there is no resurrection. Some persons in the similar physical identification of Jesus, might have had their studies in Indian Universities and might have preached similar preachings till their old age.

As written in Luke 2:42, at the age of 12 years itself Jesus habitually attended synagogues and used to sit with the Jewish teachers, questioning them and also answering to the teachers on spiritual matters,  amazingly and  intelligently.  Those people were astonished and surprised and said, “How does this man (Jesus) know so much when he had never had any training”, (John 7:15).

But the present day unbelievers propagate that Jesus had his studies (training) in Universities.  If a person had  his studies in Universities, he would somewhere in his lifetime, express his knowledge pertaining to the studies he has made.

But  Jesus always said about his Father, the God, his attachment with God, and about Heaven,  and of Salvation, as seen in the gospels.  He never exalted his might but he fulfilled the wish of God who sent him to this world. Jesus mentioned about the Law of God as said by Moses and how those prophecies are fulfilled.

Jesus told about the plan of God to provide salvation to the human soul, the fulfillment of prophecies on his birth, the process of  crucifixion on calvary and resurrection on the third day. And His appearances to his disciples and many others are the witnesses and the life history of people who lived with Jesus, their commitment and their life to tell the truth and their witness till death, are still alive in history.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, the evil spirit is trying to mislead and weaken the believers with false attributions. Strengthen us and save us from such things, through your word. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing from devil, speech and sight to a dumb and blind person
scripture: Some people brought to Jesus, a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon. Jesus healed the man, so that he was able to  talk and see. The crowds were all amazed  at what Jesus  had done. “Could he be the Son of David?”, they asked.

When the Pharisees heard this, they replied, “He drives out demons only because their ruler Beelzebul gives him power to do so”. Jesus knows what they are thinking, as he said to them, “ Any country that divides itself into groups which fight each other, will not last very long. And any town or family that divides itself into groups which fight each other, will fall apart.

So if one group is fighting another in Satan”s kingdom, that means that it is already divided into groups and will soon fall apart. It is not Beelzebul, but God’s spirit, who gives the power to drive out demons, which proves that “the kingdom of God has already come upon you”. “No man can break into a strong man’s house and take away his belongings, unless he first ties up the strongman, then he can plunder his house”. ”Anyone who is not for me is really against me; anyone who doesn’t help me gather is really scattering”.
meditation: “And so I tell you that people can be forgiven any sin and any evil thing they say, but whoever says any evil thing against the Holy Spirit, will not be forgiven. Anyone who says something against the Son of Man can be forgiven, but whoever says something against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven -- now or ever”.

Evil spirit departing Evil spirit and Satan departing Satan is the same as one opposing and departing himself. Such a tendency leads to destroying his own house or kingdom. Satan is weak before God, but God is stronger than any one.  For that reason Jesus is called, “Wonderful counselor, Mighty God, and Eternal father and Prince of peace (Isaiah 9:6).

Jesus is the Son of God. He says that there is an excuse for those who speak against him. He prayed to God on Calvary stating that “Forgive them Father, they don't know what they are doing”. Though righteous, Jesus is born as human, he took all the sin of humans on him to make them righteous. Sin will not rule the righteous persons.

Satan and his followers cannot do anything against the righteous and Godly people. Satan dwells on sinning persons. Satan's strategy is to take hold of the sinful, weak minded and wrong doing persons by blackmailing, weakening persons to dwell on sins and thrive on them. Since Jesus is aware of the human weaknesses, he said on many occasions to be “bold and courageous”. It is a lesson for us.

No human excuses, if any one points out that he was a follower of satan. As a Son of God, and the creator, Jesus excused the  fault finding persons against him, and prayed to God '' to excuse them, since they are not aware of what they are doing.”
miracles.prayer: Our Holy Father, thank you for teaching us to be ‘bold and courageous’, when evil spirits try to deceive us with unholy and sinful thoughts and acts. We pray to protect us from  such disturbances, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a servant of a Roman Officer having authority over 100 soldiers
scripture: When Jesus entered Capernaum, a Roman Officer met him and begged for help; “Sir, my servant is sick in bed at home,  unable to move and suffering terribly.” “I will go and make him well,” Jesus said. “Oh no, Sir” answered the officer, “I do not deserve to have you come into my house, just give the order, and my servant will get well. I, too, am a man under the authority of superior officers and I have soldiers under me. I order this one “Go” and he goes and I order that one “come”, and he comes; and I order my slave to “do this” and he does it.

When Jesus heard this, he was surprised and told  the people following him, “I tell you, I have never found anyone in Israel with faith like this.  I assure that many will come from the east and the west and sit down with Abraham, Issac and Jacob at the feast in the kingdom of heaven.  But those who should be in the kingdom will be thrown into the darkness, where they will cry and grind their teeth. Jesus said this about Israelites. Then Jesus said to the officer, “Go home, what you will believe will be done for you”. And the officer's servant was healed at that very moment.
meditation: Centurion is not an Israelite. He prayed to Jesus to save his servant. God likes such kindness and love of people showing to their fellow men, who may be his servant only.  “Love thy neighbor as yourself”, is the commandment in the Old Testament in the 19th chapter of Leviticus. This is the same commandment Jesus issued as a prime one.  By loving a neighbor, though he was his servant,  the centurion got the attention and appreciation, and fulfillment of his desire to save his servant by the Grace of Jesus.

In the beginning, God created humans, as man and woman. There is no discrimination between men and women. As per His plan, some people are made as owners, some people as servants, some people as rulers and some people for being ruled. Each one has a seperate destiny and a seperate purpose.  As per 2 Timothy 2:20, “In a large house  there are dishes and bowls of all kinds: some are made of silver and of gold, others of wood and clay; some are for special occasions, others for ordinary use”.

If any one makes himself clean from all those evil things he will be used for special purposes, because he is dedicated and useful to his master, ready to be used for every special occasion.  It was written in Romans 9:21, ”After all, the man who makes the pots has the right to use the clay as he wishes,  and to make two pots from the same lump of clay, one for special occasions and the other for ordinary use”.

In order to give a special entity  for the birth of Jesus as human, God selected the Israelites as his people.  However as per their faith and commitment, he made them as Judges and kings and they are blessed with abundances. When the Isralites became unfaithful to God,  they were made as slaves, servants, handicapped etc. It was the plan of God to set them right. All humans are equal to God. Though the Isralites are selected  for his purpose,  He commanded to show equality and love towards the other people living with them. (see Leviticus 19:34)

The centurion though has a command over 100 soldiers, he humbled before Jesus as God, and prayed to heal his servant, by telling a word to the illness, so that the servant gets healed. The centurion believed that God will heal gentiles (other than Isralites also) by His grace and he prayed with obedience. He and his family got the fruit of his obedience and faith in their lives.
The prayer of the centurian is for healing of his servant only, but God saved and blessed  him and his family with abundance.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, you are the only God, who shows mercy and blesses any person that humbles before you without any discrimination. Correct us in our lives, to humble before you and to live according to your wish. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a sick suffering since 38 years at a water pond called Bethesda on a Sabbath day
scripture: called Bethesda on a  sabbath day.  (John 5: 2-15)

Near the Sheep Gate in Jerusalem,  there is a pool with five porches, in  Hebrew it is called Bethesda. A large crowd of sick people were lying in the porches  -- the blind, the lame and the paralyzed. A man was there, who had been ill for 38 years.

Jesus saw him lying there, and he knew that the man had been ill for such a long time; so he asked him, “Do you want to get well?” The sick man answered “Sir, I have no one here to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up; while I am trying to get in, somebody else gets there first.” Jesus said to him, “Get up and pick up your mat and walk.” Immediately the man got well; he picked up his mat and started walking.
meditation: The day this happened was a sabbath day, so the Jewish authorities told the man who had been healed, “This is a sabbath day and it is against our Law for you to carry your mat”. He answered, “The man who made me well told me to pick up my mat and walk.” They asked him, “Who is the man who told you to do this?”.

But the man who had been healed did not know who Jesus was, for there was a crowd in that place, and Jesus had slipped away.  Afterwards, Jesus found the healed person in the Temple and said, “Listen you are well now; so stop sinning or something worse  may happen to you”. Then the man left and told the Jewish authorities that it was Jesus who had healed him.

So the Jewish authorities began to plan to persecute Jesus, because he had done this  healing on a Sabbath day. Jesus answered them, “My father is always working, and I too must work.”  This saying made the Jewish authorities all the more determined to kill Jesus,  for not only had he broken the sabbath Law, but had said that God was  his own father and in this way had made himself equal with God.

The person who was unable to move at the water pool for thirty eight years, when asked by Jesus to carry his mat and walk, healed and started walking, while carrying his own mat. It was a miracle. Instead of looking at the godliness in Jesus, and without observing the prophecies on the coming of the Messiah, the Pharisees gave more importance to the customs. They started to find reasons to kill Jesus.

When Jesus found that the sickness was  due to his sin, he said to the sick person, to avoid further sickness, not to do any more sin hereafter. Sickness can be the consequence of sin and it may lead to death also. Romans 6:23 says that “for sin pays its wage in death”.  Jesus wanted us to learn, in order to avoid further illness, all  the healed persons are advised to keep themselves absolutely free from sin.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father,  Thank you for teaching us stating that sickness can be the consequence of our sin, and that it may lead to death. You also taught as a warning that sin after healing may lead to further severe consequences. Help us to protect from such consequences, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Feeding more than 5000 men after blessing five loaves and two fish
scripture: two fish. (Matthew 14: 14-21), (Mark 6; 35-44),

When Jesus saw the large crowd following him, his heart was filled with pity for them,  and he healed those who were ill. That evening the disciples  came to him and said, “It is already very late, and this is a lonely place. Send the people away and let them go to the villages and buy food for themselves”. “They don't have to leave”, answered Jesus. You yourselves give them something to eat”.
meditation: “All we have here are five loaves and two fish”,  they replied.  “Then bring them here to me”,  Jesus said. He ordered the people to sit down on the grass, then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven and gave thanks to God.

He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples distributed them to the people. Everyone ate and had enough. The disciples took up twelve baskets full of what was left over. The number of men who ate was  about five thousand men, not counting the women and children.

The word says that “Jesus took the bread and gave thanks to God”. Jesus can do the same miracle just like the Isralites were fed from the sky in the days of Moses.  But he multiplied what he had in his hands. Five thousand men (other than women and children) were satisfactorily fed by Jesus and there remained   twelve baskets of the blessed pieces of food.  This miracle was done by Jesus by his grace towards the crowd following him and for the glory of God.
The fact of pooling the remaining pieces after full and satisfactory feeding of the crowd, shows the abundance of grace in the hands of Jesus.

John 6:12 says “When they were all full, Jesus said to his disciples, gather the pieces left over, let us not waste any”. Jesus desired that whatever blessing  received from God, it should not be left unnoticed or un-used or misused, or wasted. No man can live without a blessing from God.

In the parable of talents given to three servants, the owner appreciated both the persons, who are given 5 talents and 2 talents and who improved the talents given and handed over to the owner stating, “Well done, you good and faithful servant”. ( See Mathews 25:14-29 and Luke 19:13-26).

Everybody is given talents by God. It is a lesson for us that we are supposed to improve and handover our talents to the owner ie., God. If we do not improve and bury those God given talents, as said in that parable, we are bound to face curse from God.
miracles.prayer: Our wonderful Father, Thank you for the blessing given to us with grace.  Lead us to make proper use of  all the blessings and let us be eligible for more blessings. We pray in  the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Jesus walked on the sea and also made Peter walk on the sea
scripture: Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to Bethesda, on the other side of the lake. While he  sent the crowd away. He went away to a hill to pray to God. When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the lake, while Jesus was alone on land. He saw that his disciples were rowing against the wind, so some time between three and six O'clock in the morning he came to them, walking on the water. “It's a ghost”,  they thought, and screamed.

They were all terrified when they saw Jesus walking on sea water. Jesus spoke to them at once “Courage” he said, “It is I, don't be afraid”.  Then Peter spoke up, “Lord, if it is really you, order me to come out on the water to you”. “Come”, answered Jesus.
meditation: So Peter got out of the boat, and started walking on the water to Jesus. But when he noticed the strong wind, he was afraid and started to sink down  in the water. “Save me Lord,” he cried. At once Jesus reached out and grabbed hold of him and said, “How little faith do you have? Why did you doubt it?”. They got into the boat, and the wind died down. The disciples in the boat worshiped Jesus. “Truly you are the Son of God!”, they exclaimed.

Walking on sea waters by Jesus and making Peter also, who asked to allow him to walk on the sea waters, show the authority Jesus had on nature and creation.  The disciples with their own eyes saw the miracle of Jesus feeding more than 5000 men on the earlier day. They feared that there was a demon walking on the sea waters. They temporarily forgot, by human instinct, that Jesus was the son of God and can save them. It shows that they didn't have their full faith in Jesus.

It is natural that if we divert our mind to worldly affairs instead of focusing on Jesus, we get doubts.  Doubt is an indication of unfaithfulness.  Peter, while walking on sea waters, doubted what he was doing and started sinking into the waters. He cried out to Jesus to save him. Jesus caught him by hand and saved him. It shows that God “never leaves or forsakes” those who keep faith in him, and sincerely pray.

It is natural to get into temptations if we look to the world, especially to those who believe in Jesus Christ. Jesus himself faced such temptations from Satan, after his Baptism and fasting prayer for forty days. The way in which Jesus  faced the temptation and replied to Satan is a great lesson for us. We can see all that in Luke chapter 4 and mathew chapter 3.

Peter started drowning in the waters when he saw the strong wind. When he realized that he was drowning, instead of asking help from fellow disciples, he prayed to Jesus to help him. Jesus caught hold of his hand and brought him into the boat. When we are in trouble, we should learn to look to Jesus for help, instead of looking for worldly solutions.
“God will never abandon the faithful” says Job 8:20. The disciples at that time could see the miracle of the son of God.
miracles.prayer: Our loving Father, teach us to look at you in our problems and temptations, instead of searching for worldly solutions.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing the daughter of a Canaan woman from the devil
scripture: A Canaanite woman, who lived in the cities of Tyre and Sidon, came to Jesus saying “Son of David” cried out, “Have mercy on me Sir, my daughter had a demon and is in a terrible condition. But Jesus did not say a word to her. His disciples came to him and begged him, “Send her away, she is following us and making all this noise”. Then Jesus replied, “I have been sent  only to the lost sheep of the people of Israel”. At this, the woman came and fell at his feet, “Help me Sir” she said.

Jesus answered, “It isn't right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs”. “That's true Sir” she answered, “but even the dogs eat the leftovers that fall from their master's table”. So Jesus answered her, “You are a woman of great faith, what you want will be done for you”. And at that very moment her daughter was healed.
meditation: People, other than Isralites are called gentiles. Canaanite is a gentile. Jesus wanted to test her faith, and initially showed no response to her prayer and delayed healing for a short time. According to this miracle, it is learnt that everybody, including gentiles are entitled for salvation, not only healing, if they are stubborn in their faith in Jesus.

There is no discrimination for God, because of one’s sect, whether Israelite or other than Israelite (ie., Gentile). “Turn to me now, and be saved, people all over the world. I am the only God there is”, God says in Isaiah 43:22. The illiterate shepherds who do not know about God's Law, were informed about the birth of the Son of God “as a great joy to all the people'' (Luke 2:10).

When Jesus was brought to temple for the first time, there was a God-fearing man called Simeon.  He was called by the Holy Spirit to the temple at the same time and he professed on Jesus as Lord’s promised Messiah for human salvation, professed among others stating that “A light to reveal your will to the Gentiles". It was mentioned in Luke 2:32. All these reveal God's plan for human salvation, irrespective of an Israelite or gentile.

Adam and Eve were sent out of Eden on account of their disobedience. They started multiplying. God loved and selected their descendant  Abraham as His plan to take back all the people for salvation through the son of God as human.  Salvation is meant not only for Isralites but to all mankind. God's plan was prophesied as mentioned in the Bible. Many people prior to Israel, such as Adam, Eve, Novah, Abraham, Issac etc are all faithful to God. Abraham is called the father of faith, to all who have faith in God.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, by faith only you allowed us, the gentiles,  into your plan for salvation.  We thank you Lord.  Strengthen us in our faith, so that we do not slip out from your way. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a deaf and stammering person
scripture: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was deaf and could hardly speak, and they begged Jesus to place his hands on him. So Jesus took him off alone, away from the crowd,  put his finger in the man's ears, spat, and touched the man's tongue. Then Jesus looked up to heaven, gave a deep groan, and said to the man, “Ephphatha'', which means “open up”.

At once the man was able to hear, his speech impediment was removed, and he began to talk without any trouble. Then Jesus ordered the people not to speak of it to any one, but the more he ordered not to speak of it to any one, the more they spoke.  And all who heard were completely amazed. “How well he does everything” they exclaimed, “He even causes the deaf to hear and the dumb to speak”.
meditation: Those who have faith on Jesus, brought the deaf and dumb person to Jesus for healing.  They prayed to Jesus to simply put his hand on that person. This problem might be due to physical infirmity. To rectify this problem  Jesus took him out to a lonely place, prayed to God and set him right.

In the Bible, on many occasions, Jesus preferred to go to a lonely place, to pray to God. Jesus sent the crying people out, when he raised the dead daughter of Jairus. We can learn from this, that when we make personal prayers and when we want to meditate on the word of God, we should prefer to go alone and to get the coolness and calmness, to avoid worldly disturbances, and concentrate our mind and soul on God. It will help us to hear God's guidance.
miracles.prayer: Our loving Father, Thank you for teaching us to learn and exclusively enjoy your presence. Teach us to set right our behavior in your presence.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Feeding more than 4000 by blessing 7 loaves and some small fish
scripture: small fish.  (Matthew 15: 32-39)  (Mark 8: 1-10),

Jesus called his disciples to him and said, “I feel sorry for these people because they have been with me for three days and now have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away without feeding them, for they might faint on their way home”. The disciples asked him, “Where will we find enough food in this desert to feed this crowd?”
meditation: “How much bread have you?”, Jesus asked. “Seven loves” they answered “and a few small fish”. So Jesus ordered the crowd to sit on the ground. Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, gave thanks to God, broke them, and gave them to the disciples; and the disciples distributed them to the people.  They all ate and had enough. Then the disciples took up  seven baskets full of leftover food. The number of men who ate was four thousand, not counting the women and children.

The disciples asked Jesus ”where will we find enough food in this desert to feed the crowd?”. This is the same question asked by the disciples in the earlier miracle of feeding more than 5000 men. They have seen the same miracle by Jesus with their own eyes, but did not have enough faith in Jesus. When he told them that he felt sorry for the crowd, the disciples did not recollect the earlier miracle.
Then Jesus made them to recollect the earlier miracle.  Because Jesus loved  his disciples and told them to have faith and be strong in him. Jesus loves the people who tasted him and turned to him.

Jesus excuses such people by warnings through the Holy spirit, since people are humanly weak. This was explained by Jesus as a parable, about the prodigal son. From our side, we should be conscious enough to observe the threats and troubles in our lives, to look and hear the warnings of the Holy Spirit.

Similar miracle was done by God through prophet Elisha. It was written in the 2nd Kings in the fourth chapter, that there were about 100 people starving. One person from Bielshalisha came with 20 loaves and some fruits came before Elisha and gave him.

When Elisha prayed to God, the small food and fruits available on hand  were blessed by God and multiplied to feed all the 100 people, there remained some more food after all the people had their food enough. It shows the  abundance of the grace of God.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, we are enjoying all the blessings from you, and still forget them and keep ourselves at a distance from you.  Kindly forgive us and save us from such weakness, we pray in  the name of Jesus Chist.  Amen.

miracles.title: Transfiguration of Jesus
scripture: Jesus took with him Peter and the brothers James and John and led them up a mountain where they were alone.  As they looked on,  a change came over Jesus; his face was shining like the sun, and his clothes were dazzling white. Then the three disciples saw Moses and Elijah talking with Jesus. So Peter spoke up and  said to Jesus, “Lord how good it is,  that we are here. If you wish I will make three tents here, one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah”.

While he was talking, a shining cloud came over them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is my own dear Son, with whom I am pleased -- listen to him”. When the 3 disciples listen to the voice, they are so terrified that they throw themselves face downwards on the ground. Jesus came to them and touched them, and said “Get up”, he said. “Don't be afraid.” So they looked up and saw no one there but Jesus.
meditation: Moses was the person who had about 40 years of personal experience with God. According to Bible schoolers this happened to Moses 1500 years before Christ. In Malachi 4:5, it was written that “But before  the great and terrible day of the Lord comes, I will send you the prophet Elijah”. John the Baptist was born with the spirit of prophet Elijah. It was professed 500 years before John the Baptist was born.

It was written in the Gospel according to John 1:15 stating that Jesus existed before he (John the Baptist)  was born and that he cried out about Jesus that “This is the one I was talking about and clarified that he (John the Baptist) was not Messiah or Elijah.

Transfiguration was a blessed appearance to those persons that existed at that time,  to see Moses and Elijah speaking to Jesus at the time of transfiguration. It was written in the Bible that, at the time of the second coming of Jesus, the blessed human beings get transfiguration and will be lifted up along with Jesus.

It was a great miracle to see that, after transfiguration Jesus speaking to Moses and Elijah, witnessed by the disciples with human eyes and to identify them as Moses and Elijah, and after speaking to Jesus, Moses and Elijah were lifted up by cloud, and the disciples could  be able to hear the voice  of God from the cloud. It was also a miracle that Jesus got transfiguration from human to Godly look and again coming  back as human.  It was a miracle that normal human beings like Peter, James and John  could physically see the miracle.

We saw in the Bible that prophets heard God's voice. It was a miracle that very normal people like Peter, James and John had the privilege to hear God's voice. It was a rare witness by God himself about Jesus. At the time when Jesus took Baptism, “heaven was opened and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came from heaven saying, “You are my own dear Son, I am pleased with you”.

It was first in human life that the presence of God the Father by voice, Jesus as Son and the Holy Spirit happened. At the time of transfiguration, normal people could be able to hear God's voice, God's witness about Jesus. It was a rare occasion. We could not see that miracle but we are believing. We are more blessed than those who could hear and believe than those who sew that miracle.

Some people wrongly say that Elijah was reborn as John the Baptist. As per the Bible there is no rebirth of a person after death. Elijah is Elijah. John the Baptist is a separate person. The spirit and power of Elijah led John the Baptist, for some time. According to the Bible, the prophets prophesied with the help of the Holy Spirit.
miracles.prayer: Our wonderful Father, thank you for strengthening us to reveal the unity of trinity ie.Father, Son and the Holy Spirit.  Protect our faith in your grace.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a boy suffering from epileptic disease caught by the devil
scripture: caught by the devil. (Matthew 17:14-21)

A man came to Jesus, knelt before him and said, “Have mercy on my son, he is an epileptic and has such terrible fits that he often falls in the fire or into water. I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him.”  Jesus answered “How unbelieving and wrong you are, how long must I stay with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here to me.”
meditation: Jesus gave a command to the demon, and it went out of the boy, and at that very moment he was healed. “It was because you haven't enough faith”,  Jesus said. “I assure you that if you have faith as big as a mustard seed, you can say to this hill, ‘Go from here to there’ and it will go.  You could do anything”.

Nothing is impossible to God. The disciples are supposed to put their full faith in Jesus as Sons of God. Those who put their faith on Jesus were called as sons of God and therefore they were given the same authority as Jesus. For those who do not have faith or for those who cannot put their full faith in Jesus and for those who misuse the God given authority, the authority of God will not work out.

Jesus said in John 14:12, “I am telling the truth; whoever believes in me will do what I do -- yes, he will do even greater things, because I am going to the Father”. The miracles and healings done by such disciples and apostles are written in the Bible which were placed  after the four Gospels in the new testament.

Mustard seed is very small. A hill cannot be moved by human strength. It is impossible to move a hill by word of mouth. But such an impossible task can be done by a mustard like small faith in God, said Jesus to his disciples. Faith works miracles. Jesus said in Mark 9:23, “If you yourself can !, everything is possible for the person who has faith”.
“How long must I stay with you?” said Jesus to his disciples.  It shows that he has to leave the disciples and that he has to leave them shortly, after fulfilling God’s plan.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, Thank you for considering us to be your children and as descendants by our faith.  Teach us  and lead us in your blessings, We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Payment of tax by a shekel found from the mouth of a fish
scripture: from the mouth of a fish.   (Matthew 17: 24-27)

When Jesus and his disciples came to Capernaum, the collectors of the temple-tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”. “Of course,” Peter answered. When Peter went into the house, Jesus spoke up first, “Simon,  what is your opinion?  Who pays duties or taxes to the kings of this world? The citizens of this country or the foreigners?”. “The foreigners,” answered Peter.
meditation: “Well then,” replied Jesus, “that means that the citizens don't have to pay. But we don't want to offend those people. So go to the lake and drop in a line, pull up the first fish you hook, and in its mouth you will find a coin worth enough  temple-tax for me and  yours. Take it and pay them our taxes.

Every ruler on earth governs with my help, statesmen and noble men alike” says in Proverbs 8:16. “Everyone must obey the State authorities, because no authority exists without God’s permission”, says Paul in Romans 13:1.  Whatever authority on earth is all the gift of  God. Jesus taught us to honor authority.

When Jesus was asked “Is it against our law to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor?”  Jesus clarified, “pay the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and pay God what belongs to God”. We can see this at Matthews 22:21, Mark 12:17, and Luke 20:25.

John the Baptist was killed when he pointed out the misuse of power by the king. In the new Testament days many Apostles were tortured and killed when they pointed out the wrong things done by the kings. All they are prepared to die to witness the truth and love, shown by Jesus, besides honoring earthly authority.

In the old testament, Shedrek, Meshak and Abednego, while honoring their king as king, clearly stated that they will bow down and pray to the Almighty God only. They  declined to bow down and pray to the golden idol installed by the king, ignoring God. They became path finders and role models in history.

Shekel is a coin of those days. When Jesus asked Peter to bring a shekel from the mouth of the first fish caught in the net. Jesus gave instructions to somebody (ie Peter), but the fish obeyed to find a shekel in the Pond, caught it with its mouth and prepared itself ready to be caught to the net spread by Peter as a first fish for catch, is all a wonderful miracle.

When a fish in a pond is ready to follow up the instructions of Jesus, it is the man,  who was created with His features and who was given free liberty to obey or disobey his  creator,  misusing his liberty.           .

In the old testament, Jonah the prophet was asked by God to go to Nineveh to tell the people to rectify themselves and turn to God. When Jonah disobeyed God and was making a journey to another town, God sent a storm and Jonah was thrown into the sea, where a big fish caught hold of Jonah and brought him back to Nineveh, honoring the direction of God. Prophet Elijah was provided food by crows in God's direction (1 Kings 17:4).

When Daniel was put in the lion's cage, the hungry lions were kept quiet by God in front of Daniel (Daniel 6:23). Fish in Water, birds in air, hungry and ferocious animals also waited for the orders of God. But the man is misusing his liberty and authority and disobeying the creator's plans and falling into sin.
miracles.prayer: Our wonderful Father,  thank you for teaching us to  honor authority  in this world, since all the authority is given by you alone.  Jesus showed us practically, by suffering death on cross,  to fulfill your eternal plan. Teach us to understand and live, to properly use the authority given to us.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing two blind persons on the roadside
scripture: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd was following. Two blind men who were sitting by the road heard that Jesus was passing by, so they began to shout, “Son of David, take pity on us, Sir ''. The crowd scolded them and told them to be quiet.  But they shouted even more loudly, “Son of David, take pity on us, Sir''.

Jesus stopped and called them “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked them. “Sir” they answered, “We want you to give us our sight”. Jesus had pity on them and touched their eyes. At once they were able to see, and they followed Jesus.
meditation: There is no possibility for blind persons to see Jesus. They believed by the saying of the people that Jesus was Messiah, son of David and that he can heal and give them sight. Though they were blind and cannot see anybody, they simply believed that Jesus can show mercy on them and can make them see. They constantly and desperately prayed (by shouting) with faith, and hence they got the grace of Jesus. We are to continuously place our requirements  on Jesus, with faith and hope.
“Ask, and you will receive; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you”, said Jesus in Matthews 7:7. Whatever we do, we should do it in faith. It is a lesson from God.

The gift of sight was not given to them initially. But when they heard of Jesus, they put faith in him and could get the sight. Some people may not be given all the gifts when they are born. We should learn that we can make use of the God given gifts or talents to the fullest extent, keep faith in God and by constant prayers, we can get all the talents.
miracles.prayer: Our loving Father, teach us to make proper use of the blessings and talents given to us., so that we get more and more blessings in our lives.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a blind person at Bethsaida village on a Sabbath day
scripture: Sabbath day.  (Mark 8: 22-26) (John 9: 1-7)

When Jesus and his disciples came to Betsaida, where some people brought a blind man to Jesus and begged him to touch him.  His disciples asked him, “Teacher, whose sin caused him to be born blind? Was it his own or his parent’s sin? Jesus answered, “His blindness has nothing to do with his sins or of his  parents' sin. He is blind so that God's power might be seen at work in him.
As long as it is day, we must keep on doing the work of him who sent me, night is coming when no one can work. While I am in the world, I am the light for the world”.
meditation: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village.  After spitting on the man's eyes, Jesus placed his hands on him and asked him, “can you see anything?”. The man looked and said, “Yes, I can see the people,  but they look like trees walking about''. Jesus again placed his hands on the man's eyes. This time the man looked intently, his eyesight returned,  and he saw everything clearly. Jesus sent him home with the order, “Don't go back  into the village”.

In  John's Gospel, it is written that Jesus spat on the ground and made some mud with the spittle, he applied the mud on the man's eyes and said, “Go and wash your face in the pool of Siloam”. This name means “sent”. So the man washed his eyes and  face and came back with clear vision.

It was mentioned in Mattews 11th chapter, that the village of Bethsaida was full of sin. Jesus would have healed the blind man instantly with a single word. But it was written that Jesus took by hand to outside the village, and also that after healing, he ordered him not to go into the village, but go to his home. It appears from the above that God wants us, whosoever wishes to get healed, to get seperated from the sin or from the sinning atmosphere.

The Judas at that time were trying to collect witnesses against Jesus, to somehow find fault with him, and to ex-communicate those who said Jesus was the son of God or prophet. Judas strictly followed the Law that nobody should work on a Sabbath day. Judas did not accept Jesus as son of God as he did healings on Sabbath days, which is against their tradition.
And the Judas are ex-communicating those who believe in Jesus as the son of God. Parents of the blind person escaped Judas, stating that their son was a major and he can be questioned directly.

When Judas asked the healed person about Jesus, he categorically explained to them how he was healed and started to ask them whether they ( ie.,Judas ) also believe in Jesus and become disciples to him. Therefore Judas ex-communicated the healed  person. The faith of that healed person is great, and he spoke the truth openly,  though he knows that he gets ex-communication from that Society.

Jesus said “I am the light for the world”. Jesus said that as long as it is day we must keep on doing the work of God who sent him. It is an indication that he has to die and till then he has to do the work of God. It was his prophecy  on his death.

After healing, the blind man said that people are like moving trees. So he knows trees and people also before he attained blindness. He may not be a born blind person, but he might have acquired blindness after some time for some other reason. This blind person was brought with a great faith to get his sight. Jesus clarified that the reason for  blindness of this person was done for the glory of God.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, thank you for your blessings in our lives. Teach us to be your witnesses for all the blessings.  We pray in the name of Jesus Chist.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a dumb person caught by devil, while the disciples could not heal
scripture: could not heal.   (Mark 9: 17-29) (Luke 9: 38-43)

A man was  arguing with his disciples. When questioned he answered, “Teacher, I brought my son to you because he has an evil spirit in him and he cannot talk. Whenever he attacks him, it throws him to the ground, and he foams at the mouth, grits his teeth,  and becomes stiff all over.  I asked your disciples  to drive the spirit out but they could not.”

Jesus said to his disciples, “How unbelieving you people are, how long must I stay with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.” The disciples brought him to Jesus. As soon as the spirit saw Jesus, it threw the boy into a fit, so that he fell on the ground and rolled round, foaming at the mouth.

“How long has he been like this?”  Jesus asked the father of that person.  “Ever Since he was a child” he replied. “Many times the evil spirit tried to kill him by throwing him in the fire and into water. Have pity on us and help us, if you possibly can”. “Yes'' Jesus said, “If you yourself can, everything is possible for the person who has faith”. The father at once cried out, “I do have faith, but not enough. Help me to have more”.

Jesus noticed that the crowd was  closing in on them, so he gave a command to the evil spirit, “Deaf and dumb spirit” he said, “I order  you to come out of the boy and never go into him again”. The spirit screamed, threw the boy into a bad fit, and came out.  The boy looked like a corpse, and everyone said, “He is dead''.

But Jesus took the boy by  hand and helped him to raise, and he stood up. After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, “why couldn't we  drive the spirit out?”. “Only prayer can drive this kind out”, answered Jesus, “Nothing else can''.
meditation: In this healing, Jesus talked about the importance of belief and full faith and prayer. The father of the sick boy prayed to Jesus to help him from his unfaithful condition. This shows the honesty, acceptance of his human weakness.

Jesus strengthened the faith of the father of the sick man by telling him that nothing is impossible for those who believe. Practicing for such strengthening is the lesson we are to learn.  Honesty is a stepping stone to improve faith.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious and blessing Father, thank you for teaching us on keeping faith in you with righteousness and  on our prayer life.  Help us to be honest and righteous in all our activities, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Giving life to Lazarus, who is dead
scripture: A message was sent to Jesus that his dear friend Lazarus was ill. After hearing this, Jesus said “the final result of this illness will not be the death of Lazarus, this has happened in order to  bring glory to God, and it will be the means by which the Son of God will receive glory.  But he stayed where he was for two more days. Then Jesus told his disciples to go to Judaea. “Teacher” the disciples answered “just a short time ago the people there wanted to stone you, and you are planning to go back”.

Jesus said, “A day has twelve hours, hasn't it? So whoever walks in broad daylight doesn't strumble for he sees the light of this world. But if he walks during the night, he stumbles, because he has no light. Jesus said this and then added, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I will go and wake him up”. Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead, but for your sake I am glad that I was not with him, so that you will believe. Let us go to him.”  Thomas said to his fellow disciples, “Let us all go with the Teacher, so that we may die with him”.

The disciples of Jesus tried to stop Jesus from going to that area, because the Judas are planning to kill Jesus. Judas felt that Jesus was against the Law of Moses, for Jesus opposed the worldly customs and also that Jesus himself declared that he was the Son of God.
