When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had been buried four days before. Martha went out to see Jesus and said “If you had been here, Lord, my brother would not have died. But I know that  even now God will give you whatever you ask him for.” Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in me will live, even though he dies, and whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

Deeply moved once more, Jesus went to the tomb which was a cave with a stone placed at the entrance. “Take the stone away,” Jesus ordered. Jesus looked up and said, “I thank you Father, that you listen to me. I know that you always listen to me, but I say this for the sake of the people here, so that they will believe that you sent me.” After he had said this, he called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus come out”. He came out, his hands and feet wrapped in grave clothes, and with a cloth around his face. “Untie him”, Jesus told them, “and let him go”.
meditation: Lazarus was raised to praise God, to glorify God and to the glory of the Son of God, Jesus. It was a great miracle to rise from the dead, by a word of Jesus, and Lazarus came out from the grave with his ripped body.

The words of Jesus such as “a day has twelve hours”, “daylight’, “does not stumble” are very meaningful. “A day has twelve hours” means that there is a lot of time, or enough time, to do the work of God. “daylight” means that there can be no secret and every work has to be done very transparently, and that such works “do not stumble”,  rather such things can be done very courageously, and without any fear and also with an open mind.
Wrong doers and those that do things secretly naturally stumble. There is no reason to stumble for those who do good work transparently.

It is not impossible for Jesus to heal the sick Lazarus or to raise him from the dead, even without going to that place. Jesus delayed the healing and raising from the dead. Lazarous was raised after four days of  the death, to strengthen the faith of disciples, family members of Lazarus, and the local people and to prove that whoever keeps faith in Jesus will rise even after death.

Jesus delayed his visit to that place wantonly to strengthen  the faith of his disciples. It is not impossible for Jesus to raise the dead by his word. This is a practical demonstration of Jesus, to reveal himself to the people, that he was life and resurrection to mankind.

Some Judas are plotting to find ways and means to somehow show some wrong against  Jesus to kill him, as already observed by Thomas and other disciples. Some people believe that Jesus can heal Lazarus, or Jesus can raise Lazarus from the dead even after three days after death.

It shows that Jesus deliberately delayed that miracle to increase the faith of believers as well as unbelievers to make the miracle transparently. It was a lesson taught by Jesus that we can shatter the doubts of even unbelieving persons by following transparency.

Before commanding Lazarus to come out of the tomb, Jesus told the people to remove the stone that closed the tomb, and so they did it. Jesus can as well order the stone to give way to Lazarous to come out with life. But we can see that Jesus wants to bless human efforts,  as he likes to bless even the small  efforts done with belief.

Though Thomas followed Jesus as he believed Jesus as son of God, he behaved like a normal human unbeliever, slipped his tongue in a casual way and said “Let us all go with the Teacher, so that we may die with him”. Jesus ignored as he knew the human weaknesses, but blessed him to be a witness of Him till death, in India.
miracles.prayer: Our wonderful Father, thank you for teaching us to show transparency in all our walks of life, to glorify you. Lead us in  that way and we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a daughter of Abraham on a Sabbath day from being caught by the devil for 18 years
scripture: being caught by the  devil since 18 years. (Luke 13: 10-17)

One Sabbath day Jesus was teaching in a synagogue. A woman there had an evil spirit that had made her ill for eighteen years, she was bent over and could not straighten at all.  When Jesus saw her,  he called out to her, “Woman you are free from your illness”. He placed his hands on her and at once she straightened herself up and praised God.

The official of the synagogue was angry that Jesus had healed on the  Sabbath day, so he spoke up and said to the people, “There are six days in which we should work, so come during those days and be healed, but not on the Sabbath day.”  It shows the  unpleasantness of the official of the synagogue, that he is objecting to the persons requiring healing, he however has no healing power of God.

The Lord answered Him, “You hypocrites, any one of you would untie his ox or his donkey from the stall and take it out to give it water on the Sabbath day.  Now here is the descendant of Abraham whom Satan has kept bound up for eighteen years, should she not be released on the Sabbath day?”.

His answer made his enemies ashamed of themselves, while the people rejoiced over all the wonderful things that Jesus did. Jesus taught the Official of the synagogue and the Judas, that it is wrong to abstain from doing good things, on the plea of Sabbath day, where everybody is supposed to observe  rest.
meditation: God blessed Abraham like anything. Remembering that, Jesus found her as the daughter of Abraham, pitied her and healed her.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, thank you for teaching us to give priority in doing good things, life saving activities and  helping others even setting aside the  customs and conventions.  Help us  to lead such life, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a man suffering from swollen hands and legs on a Sabbath day
scripture: on a Sabbath day.   (Luke 14: 1-6)

On one Sabbath day Jesus went to eat a meal at the home of the leading Pharisees, and people were watching Jesus closely. A man whose legs and arms were swollen came to Jesus, and Jesus asked the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, “Does our Law allow healing on a Sabbath day or not”. But they could not say anything.

Jesus took the man, healed him, and sent him away.  Then he said to them, “If any one of you had a son  or an ox that happened to fall in a well on a Sabbath day, would you not pull him out at once on the Sabbath day itself? But they were not able to answer him about this.
meditation: Officials of Law and Pharisees felt that Jesus was against the Law. Jesus was teaching at the synagogues and holding discussions with Officials, teachers and Pharisees and many people are following Jesus. One of the leading Pharisees invited Jesus for a meal. So Jesus came to his house. Some of the Pharisees are observing Jesus from all corners to find a fault with him, when Jesus saw a person with swollen legs and hands.

Since Jesus can read the minds of the people, Jesus asked the Pharisees and the other officials, as to what they would do if one of their sons or an ox fell in a well on a Sabbath day, and whether they would pull him or pull it up immediately or not? This was the question to the Pharisees before Jesus healed the sick. They could not answer, they kept quiet. Hence Jesus healed that sick person.  This was an act of transparency. Jesus taught us to follow transparency even when we intend to do good things.
miracles.prayer: Thank you Father, for you know our thoughts and how you controlled your criticizers by following transparency.  Help us to follow you in our lives. We pray in the name of Jesus Chist.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing 10 cancer patients
scripture: As Jesus made his way to Jerusalem, he went along the border between Samaria and Galilee. He was going into a village when he was met by ten men suffering from dreaded skin disease. They stood at a distance and shouted  “Jesus!  Master!, take pity on us”.

Jesus saw them and said to them,  “let the priests examine you”. On the way they got healed and were made clean. When one of them saw that  he was healed, he came back praising God in a loud voice. He threw himself on the ground at Jesus' feet, and thanked him.

The man was a Samaritan. Jesus said, “there were ten men healed, where are the other nine? Why is this foreigner, a gentile, the only one, who came back to give thanks to God”. And Jesus said to him, “Get up and go, your faith has made you well”.
meditation: In this healing, we can see that to get pity from God on us, we can be anyone, Isralite or gentile. Jesus did not touch them. Jesus did not speak to them to get healed. But directed them to go and show their bodies to the priest. This was a miraculous healing by Jesus, even without touching or atleast without speaking a word of healing.

During those days, this dreaded skin disease was a very dangerous disease. Such diseased persons were not allowed to move in among the people, but they were to live outside the village. This disease can attack any one, Israelite or gentile.

When all the ten diseased persons were asked by Jesus to go and show their bodies to the priest, they were simply moving to show their bodies to the priest. When one of them observed that he was healed, he came back to Jesus, and started praising God, by falling on the ground before Jesus. He was a Samaritan.

The other nine healed persons gave preference to show their bodies to the priest instead praising God and give thanks to Jesus, in the first instance. They gave preference to show themselves as cleaned.

Thus Jesus exposed the mentality of people in general. But he did not curse them to get back the disease, because he knows the human weaknesses. Jesus enhanced the faith of the Samaritan, who praised God.
miracles.prayer: Our gracious Father, thank you for teaching us  how to honour God after getting a blessing or a healing from sickness. Help us to  give a thanksgiving life, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing a beggar on a roadside for his sight
scripture: At Jericho, as Jesus was leaving with his disciples and a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting by the road. When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, “Jesus,  son of David,  pity on me”.

Many of the people called him and told him to be quiet. But he shouted even more loudly, “Son of David, take pity on me”. Jesus stopped and said “call him”. So they called the blind man “Cheer up” they said. “Get up, he is calling you.”

He threw off his cloak, jumped up and came to Jesus. “What do you want me to do for you?”, Jesus asked him. “Teacher,” the blind man answered, “I want to see again”. “Go” Jesus told him, “Your faith has made you well”. At once he was able to see and follow Jesus.
meditation: It was a special incident where Jesus stopped himself and waited for the praying person to heal him. This incident showed the intensity of the cry of the sick which could stop the Son of God to heal him.

“Take pity on me” prayed the blind man. When he was told that Jesus was calling him, even before he was healed, he expressed his faith by throwing his clock, he expressed his faith in Jesus, and he was healed. We should learn here that when we pray to God for our needs, we should feel and behave that God has answered our prayer.
miracles.prayer: Our merciful Father, thank you for teaching us  how to behave after we earnestly pray to you and to enjoy the satisfaction of receiving the result of our prayer.  Help us for such a satisfactory life, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Healing the ear of the high Priest's slave
scripture: One of the twelve disciples of Jesus, came forward to kiss Jesus, in order to handover Jesus to the soldiers.   Jesus said “Is it with a kiss, that you betray the Son of Man”, and told him “Be quick about it, my friend”. When the disciples who were with Jesus saw what was going to happen they asked, “Shall we use our swords, Lord?”. And one of them struck the High Priest's  slave and cut off his right  ear.

“Put your sword back in its place” Jesus said to him, “All who take the sword will die by the sword. “Don't you know that I could call on my father for help and at once he would send me more than twelve armies of angels? But in that case, how could the scriptures come true which say that this must happen”.

Jesus said, “enough of this”. He touched the man's ear and healed him. The slave's name was Malchus. Then Jesus said to the chief priests and officers of the temple guard and the elders who had come there to get him arrested, “Did you have to come with swords and clubs, as though I were an outlaw. I was with you in the temple every day, and you did not try to arrest me. But this is your hour to act, when the power of darkness rules.  Jesus recollected the scripture of prophecy on this In Isaiah 53:2-12.

Before Jesus was handed over to the priests, and  during the passover meal (ie, Lord's supper), Jesus said, “I tell you, one of you will betray me”.  Since the crucifixion of Jesus was according to the plan of God, Jesus called Iscariot Judas as “friend” instead of calling him as “unfaithful person”.
meditation: Even in that tense situation, Jesus said to his disciples,”enough of this”, and he healed the ear of the servant of the chief Priest . Even at the hard times for us, we are supposed to show the love of God, on those who try to harm us. Jesus practically showed us ‘to love our enemy’ as said in his sermon on the mount, (Mathews 5:43).
miracles.prayer: Our loving Father, thank you for  teaching how to be  in self control, patient, and show your love even at adverse situations in our lives. Strengthen us and help us to face any problem in our lives, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

miracles.title: Jesus appears to disciples after resurrection
scripture: After resurrection, Jesus appeared to his disciples and many others. Jesus appeared once more to his disciples at Lake Tiberias. This is how it happened. Simon Peter, Thomas (called the twin), Nathaniel (the one from Cana in Galilee), the sons of Jabade, and two other disciples of Jesus were all together.  Simon Peter said to the others, “I am going fishing”. “We will come with you”, they told him. But all that night they did not catch a thing, and returned.

Jesus stood  at the water's edge and asked them ‘Young men, haven't you caught anything?’. “Not a thing” they answered. He said to them, “throw your net out on the right side of the boat, and you will catch some”. So they threw the net out and could not pull it back, because they had caught so many fish. Some of the disciples identified Jesus and  said “it is the Lord”. The other disciples came to shore in the boat, pulling the net full of fish.

They were not very far from the land, about a hundred meters  away. When they stepped ashore, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it and some bread. Jesus said “bring some of the fish you just caught”. When they dragged the net full of big fish, there were hundred and fifty three fish, but the net did not tear. So Jesus went over, took the bread,  and gave it to them, he did the same with the fish.
meditation: After the crucifixion of Jesus, all the disciples scattered to other places. Some of them went back to fishing, their traditional work. After resurrection Jesus showed himself to many of his disciples and strengthened them. Jesus pitied the shattered disciples and called “Children?” They throwed their net out for fishing as directed by Jesus and they caught  abundant fish.

The disciples had an earlier experience of such a miracle with Jesus. This increased their faith in Jesus. Jesus asked disciples for food.  Though Jesus was in a spiritual body, he gave the disciples the cooked bread and fish as food to eat. It was a miracle.

Before telling the disciples to go for fishing once again, he asked them for food initially.  But after fishing, without the effort of those disciples, Jesus gave them cooked bread and fish as food, and thus made a miracle.

After resurrection, and before he was lifted to God's  glory, Jesus strengthened the faith of his disciples, by his physical presence, by speaking to them, by asking them to put their fingers in his wounds, etc.  Jesus strengthened the faith of them, and this miracle is one of them.
Miracles and Healings by Jesus Christ
Part - 2
Lessons from Healings and Miracles.

Many lessons for us are taught from the Healings and Miracles of Jesus Christ written in the four gospels in the Bible. Some more of the lessons will be let known by meditating on them.  The Holy Spirit will help us to let us reveal in our spiritual mind some more lessons while reading and in prayerful meditation.
We may meditate on the following lessons for our spiritual understanding.
miracles.prayer: Our Father in Heaven, thank you for providing in the Holy Bible all the miracles and healings by Jesus Christ, to be witnesses for your Glory.   Help us to understand them and glorify you, we pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Forgiving and showing love towards our fellowmen
meditation: By forgiving sins, Jesus healed a sick person at the pond at Bethesda. (Matthew 9:6).  By forgiving  sins, Jesus healed a person, who was kept before him by his friends, opening the roof of a house. It was narrated in the gospels  according to Mathews, Mark and Luke. Jesus said in John 5:26, “The Son of Man has power to forgive sins.”

Just as the  Father  himself is the source of life, in the same way he has made his son to be the source of life”  Jesus said. As Son of God, Jesus came to the world, he has the authority to forgive the sins of men, to heal the sick and do miracles with love and compassion and to fulfill the wish of God. “To provide salvation to all the people, is the wish of God” says John 6:4.

Jesus taught the disciples how they should pray to God, at Matthews 6:9-13. One part of the prayer is that “Forgive us the wrongs we have done, as we forgive the wrongs that others have done to us”. As human beings we can forgive any one but it is very difficult to forgive our enemy.

Mathews 6:14 says, ”If you forgive others the wrong they have done to you, your father in heaven will also forgive you”. Mark 11:25 says, “And when you stand and pray, forgive any thing you may have against any one, so that your father in heaven forgive the wrongs you have done”. Unless we forgive our enemy, how come God forgives us? It is impossible to find love and compassion and equality with those who cannot forgive.

According to the Law in those days, killing by throwing stones till death was the rule against a lady caught red handedly in adultery.  Jesus said to those who are ready to throw stones  against her, “Whichever one of you committed no sin may throw the first stone  at her”.

All those persons came with stones, left that place one by one, as they found themselves with one sin or the other. Then Jesus said to her, “I do not condemn you either. Go, but do not sin again”. (John 8:11). Jesus forgave her, which shows his concern towards sinners.

Jesus was accused for saying that he was the son of God. “Which one of you can prove that I am guilty of sin? If I tell you the truth, why do you not believe me?” Jesus questioned  as said in John 8:46.

Jesus showed his love and compassion towards those crucifying him and said   “Forgive them Father, they don't know what they are doing”  prayed Jesus to God as said in  Luke 23-34.  Jesus taught that doing is more important than telling.

Loving and forgiving are combined in the command of Jesus in Luke 10:27, “Love their neighbor as thy love yourself”. Jesus is the incarnation of Love. Those who desire healing and those who pray for healing, should maintain love and harmony with their neighbors. Jesus is the only God who said  “Love thy enemy”.

First John 1:9 says, “If we confess our sins to God, we will follow his promise and do what is right, he will forgive our sins and purify us from all our wrong doings”. We can learn from this that confessing our sins before God is the first step to get forgiveness for our sins from God and then get healed, and thereafter we are to keep ourselves away from sins.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our loving Father,  impart us to love everybody, so that we can forgive those who do wrong towards us and thereby we get forgiveness for our sins from you. We pray in the name of Jesus christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Merciful to others & selflessness in helping
meditation: Jesus came to this world as a human to provide relief to the human from the bondage of sins. In the process of his plan to save the human from the bondage of sins, he healed the sick who came across him, and who prayed to him to heal them from human sickness, because he was a kind God.

In some instances, even without asking him to heal, Jesus healed a daughter of Abraham who was suffering from weakness. He did a miracle by giving life to the son of a widow on the way to the burial ground, giving sight to the blind and speech to the dumb, and healing from cancer to ten sufferers, and many who do not have any support from the society. All those healings and miracles were done by the mercy of Jesus.

Jesus  healed by showing mercy to the prayers of parents, friends and also the owners for their servants. Yayir is a parent praying for his daughter. Friends of the sick person brought down their sick friend from opening the tiles of a house to put him before Jesus. A centurion prayed for his sick servant. (See Matthews 8:5-13).  Jesus healed such cases of healings, and of those prayed to him for healing of their beloved ones.

Because of his healings and also because of the teachings, many people followed Jesus for many days together not bothering about their food. Jesus pitied those following crowds and did miracles such as feeding more than 5000 people at one occasion and more than 4000 people on another occasion, blessing the available food insufficient  not even to one person. All those miracles are done by Jesus with pity on the  crowds following him.

God is good to everyone and has compassion on all he made” says David in psalms 145:9. Apostle John in his first letter in 3:17 says, “if a rich person sees his brother in need, yet closes his heart against his brother, how can he claim that he loves God? My children, our love should not be just words and talk, it  must be true love which shows itself in action". Jude in 1:22 says, “show mercy towards those which have doubts”, doubts about Jesus Christ.

Jesus showed  pity and compassion against the poor people who do not have any source of living. He showed a way to provide social justice and equality against the poor, which is being followed by many of the democratic countries.

A loving person will have a mind to forgive and a mind to be kind enough. In the command of Jesus “love thy neighbor”, forgiving and kindness are the basics. At the sermon on the mount, Jesus said in Mathews 5:7, “Happy are those who are merciful to others, God will be merciful to them”.  Happiness is a blessing.

In Proverbs 28:13, it is said “You will never succeed in life, if you try to hide your sins. Confess them and give them up, then God will show mercy to you”. In Mathews 7:12, Jesus said, “Do for others, what you want others to do for you.”  We should learn from this that, if we want the mercy of God on us, we should  show mercy on our fellow men, in need.

Wine exhausted at the marriage function at Kanaan. It was purely a problem of the marriage functionaries.  It was a custom to serve wine in marriages. Mary, mother of Jesus, decided to somehow help them, and she approached Jesus. Her desire was fulfilled. There is no selfishness in that act for herself.

There is no “selfishness” in the minds of those friends who brought the sick person before Jesus, after opening the roof tiles of the house. Jesus was pleased with the effort of the friends and healed the sick person.

When any person is facing trouble, whether a neighbor, a friend, a relative, a family member, a member in our congregation, a fellow resident, it is a great lesson for us that everyone is bound to respond, in such need. Such an act is an expression of love. “Love thy neighbor” says the Lord. God will surely fulfill such acts of love, if we attempt.
Jesus taught us, to pray for the sick, to render a hand to the poor, to render a helping hand to the weak and poor and helpless widows. Many of the healings of Jesus are from such cases.

Jesus said in Matthew 25:35-36, “I was hungry, you fed me, thirsty and you gave me a drink, I was a stranger, you received me in your homes, when naked and you clothed me, I was sick and you took care of me, in prison you visited me”.  He said that all those things, whenever you did this for one of the least important of these brothers of mine, you did it for me.

The mind of selflessness gets the mind of pity towards the needy. The persons who follow the command of Jesus ''Love thy neighbor like you” only can show pity on the needy  people. We are to learn that God's help will be there for such activity, because God likes such activities.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our merciful Father, We get mercy from you, if we show it to our neighbor in need. Provide us with such a compassionate mind to live a life that pleases you. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Righteousness and obedience
meditation: In the miracle of healing from a dumb devil, where the disciples could not do, the father of the victim, prayed Jesus, to help him to hold on to his faith or to restrain him from unfaithfulness. Jesus saw his righteousness and thought of his mind, and gave fruit of his prayer by way of healing.
We are to learn here that it is not possible to get healing or the blessing of healing the sick and  God's forgiveness, unless we are completely humble and free  from our sins.

The centurion humbled himself before God's authority and showed his obedience. The centurion found the authority of Jesus as Son of God, put his faith in Jesus that Jesus will heal his servant, and prayed to Jesus to release a word of healing. The centurion believed that Jesus will pity the people having righteousness, faith and obedience. He and his family members got the fruit of their faith.

When Jesus healed, Jesus saw the acute desire of the sick, and that such a person has to repent for his sin and leave his sin. He should be honest and faithful and finally the miracle should result in the glory of God. God knows the secrets of every heart, and everything is open to God. However in order to strengthen our faith, Jesus said on many occasions “Do not fear or doubt” and “your faith has healed you”.

In the case of life given to a boy who is dead and is being taken out for burial, it is the righteous life of the mother of that boy, that  gained wisdom and favor from neighboring men. In such cases God’s favor will also add. Jesus himself interfered, without asking, and gave life to that boy.
It was written in Luke 2:52 that prior to Baptism Jesus grew both in body and in wisdom, gaining favor with God and men.

Sins will not be forgiven and can get no healing for those who pray at any range, without righteousness. Jesus said at Matthews 7:21, “Not everyone who calls me ‘Lord, Lord’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only those who do what my father in heaven wants them to do''.  “Lord bless the homes of the righteous”, says in proverbs 3:33.

Some people praise God with a thousand names or write the name of God a crore times, and some people walk on fire. It is impossible to please God by practicing and  straining their bodies, but it is the mind in our body that needs righteousness and cleanliness in our thoughts. Spirit in our body is the gift of God. It is Holy.

If we tend to commit any unholy act or thought, our mind starts alerting and correcting us. Unless we correct ourselves on the warnings of the spirit in us, we are going to get into sins and allow sin to rule us, then the Holy Spirit in us will leave us to the consequences.

One person called Simon offered money to Peter and John, “give this power of healing to me too, so that any one I place my hands on, will receive the Holy Spirit”. Peter answered, “May you and your money go to hell, for thinking that you can buy God's gift with money”. “Your heart is not right in God's sight”. (Acts 8:18-20).

There is no use of works belonging to the body, but God wants us to seek for the Holy Spirit to restore in us. Righteousness belongs to spirituality. Proverbs 3:32 says that “The Lord hates the people who do evil, but he takes righteousness into his confidence”.

Psalms says in 84:11 that, “The Lord is our protector and glorious king, blessing us with kindness and honor. He doesn't refuse any good thing”. Those who seek healing should  be righteous and leave their sins, and pray to God to forgive their sins.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our Holy God, thank you for teaching us to be righteous in our life and pure and Holy in Spirit.  Help us to be  righteous and Holy in all our walks of life. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Free healings for the glory of God
meditation: Jesus has done all the healings and miracles free of cost. Jesus Prayed God, did all healings free of cost and gave that gift to his disciples  freely and  directed them “you have received without paying, so give without being paid” (in Matthews 10:6).

But the people in those days gave importance to personal earnings and self business in the synagogues (temples). Therefore Jesus said in Mark 11:7 stating, “It is written in the scriptures that my temple will be called a house of prayer for the people of all nations, but you have turned it into a  hideout for thieves”.

Jesus overturned the business tables in the temple. In some temples people are doing business by selling Holy Water, curchiefs, Holy Oils etc misleading people in the name of faith. This trend is purely an act of the devil.

Some people feel that they please God by donations and offerings. If donations and offerings are a way to get eternal life, the wealthy people only can buy God. God has no discrimination between rich and poor. There can be no discrimination between men, rich or poor, since all are his creation.

If anybody is blessed with power or richness, the gift was only from God. God cannot be purchased. God will not bow down to any authority. Fully aware that everyone should leave the body and the world, and fully aware that worldly wealth is not permanent and to be left it on a day as it is, people feel that wealth is God. Such people cannot be convinced easily. What we can do is to pray for such people, as we are to love our neighbor.

Naaman, the commander  of the Syrian army, suffering from dreaded skin-disease, came down to the  prophet Elisha to cure him along with a large amount of several gifts, and also expecting a very grand welcome to him. The prophet sent a word to him to dip in river Jordan seven times and go back. Obedience to the word of God was the key to that healing, but not money and gifts.
Jesus told a parable of the Good Samaritan, as narrated in Luke 10:3-37. It is an example of a good neighbor, who did his best for a deprived person, irrespective of his caste, creed, religion etc..

Donations and offerings are meant for the financial requirements of the congregations or churches, for the bread and butter of the servant of God and his family, for the spread of Gospel, and for the help of the poor in the churches, etc. Such donations and offerings can be collected openly and freely, but they should not be linked with praying for healings.

It is against the will of God, to link the offerings and donations with healings in the name of God. Church servants, leaders and elders of the Church are supposed to identify such activities if any, and correct themselves. The believers in the church are also to use their mind and boldly stop such business activities in churches.

Jesus taught us to keep away from the business trends in doing healings. Jesus did all miracles free of any earthly considerations and learnt us human values. Jesus did all healings freely for the Glory of God.

After Jesus, one person called Simon offered money to Peter and John, “give this power of healing to me too, so that any one I place my hands on will receive the Holy Spirit”. Peter answered, “May you and your money go to hell, for thinking that you can buy God's gift with money”. “Your heart is not right in God's sight”. (Acts 8:18-20). This is how the early Christians did free healings and miracles for the glory of God.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, we understand that all blessings given to us are at your free will. Help us to follow you and bend our mind to be generous in helping others in need. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: No discrimination between man and woman while healing
meditation: Jesus never showed any discrimination between a man and a woman, while healing. All are equal before him. Jesus healed a man suffering from dumbness,  caught by devil, a blind person, a deaf and dumb person, a paralyzed person and so many like that, and also many women, such as a canaanite woman suffered from devil, a woman suffered 12 years from blood bleeding disease.

In the beginning, God created human beings, as man and woman. He made them as a family, and directed them to multiply and fill the earth. He created women as a helping hand to men, as wife. Man is supposed to leave his parents and live with his wife, as one body. There is no discrimination among them.

When a man and woman are made as family, they are supposed to honor each other and live happily and develop their family in all respects. If they start discriminating each other, they are inviting unhappiness, anger, unfaithfulness, enmity, thereby mental disturbances and sicknesses.

Since the first woman was made from a man, men got administrative power. When the man was tempted by  woman  for violating God's command, the woman was kept under the  control of the man, and he became the head of the family. “You (woman) will be subject to him (man),”  says the last line in Genesis 3:16.

Therefore man is called the head of the family, as far as the family is concerned. There is no discrimination in duties and responsibilities between a man and a woman. It is a lesson for us to ensure that there is no discrimination between a man and a woman in christian families.

Before independence, India suffered discrimination between man and a woman, in the name of a customary right. When a man dies his wife was also to die on the same fire. When it was observed as a wrong and inhuman custom, this discrimination and such custom was removed while framing  Indian Constitution.

Peter in his first letter in 3:7 says, “In the same way, you husbands must live with your wives with the proper understanding that they are the weaker sex. Treat them with respect because they also will receive, together with you, God's gift of life. Do this so that nothing will interfere with your prayers”. God's gift of life is equal to men and women.

Discrimination between man and woman was still continued in many other angles as customary right in some backward areas and in the minds of some persons having backward mentalities. Governments are still to make transparent rules and regulations with good commitments, to eradicate the discriminations. God will definitely help to make such good efforts.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our loving Father, thank you for teaching us to understand  your love towards us without discrimination between man and woman. Help us to follow you in our life. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: No discrimination between rich and the poor and in between owner and servant
meditation: in between owner and servant.

Among the persons approached Jesus for healing, Jairus and the Centurion belong to a rich group and they are powerful also with authority. When they prayed to Jesus for healing, the daughter of Jairus, and the servant of Centurion were healed. Poor persons like the deceased person stayed for 38 years at Bethesda, a beggar at the roadside, and many other poor persons were also healed by the mercy of Jesus.

1 Samuel 2:7, says, “He (God) makes some men poor and some others rich, he humbles some and makes some others great”. Richness and greatness are the talents given by God. It is our duty and responsibility to make proper use of them and improve the talents given by God.

1 Chronicles 29:11 says, “Everything in heaven and earth is yours (of God), and you are king,  supreme ruler over all. All riches and wealth come from you, you rule everything by your strength and power, and you are able to make any one great and strong”.

In our country, people of certain castes were not allowed to enter the temples. They were deprived of social security and also not allowed to get education along with the socially privileged students.  Though such discrimination was removed in the Constitution, still some people with backward mentalities are not correcting themselves.
There is no discrimination between rich and poor in entry in Christian temples and in Christian worships. Rich or poor, all are equal in the eyes of God, because he is the creator of all.

Jairus and Centurian are owners and they maintain servants. They prayed for the healing of their beloved persons. Jesus healed them. Blindman at roadside, deaf and dumb persons etc are all poor and they are depending on some others. But for Jesus, owners and servants are equal. Jesus healed them.

As per plan, God made some people as owners, servants, kings, judges and some as people to be ruled. Each one is destined as separate vessels for his use. 2 Timothy 2:20 says, “In a large house there are dishes and bowls of all kinds; some are made of silver and gold, others of wood and clay; some are for special occasions, others for ordinary use”.
It is clarified in Romans 9:21 stating, “Afterall, the man who makes pots has the right to use the clay as he wishes”. Creator has the power to make vessels of his choice.

Isralites, in the old testament, are the chosen people of God, for God's purpose. Because of the obedience they had shown to God, they are blessed as kings, judges, some as rich and some as owners of land and property.

When they started showing disobedience to God and sinning, God threw them to slavery, sickness, some as handicapped, and some were allowed for killing by other kings. God blesses those who follow His commandments and perform their entrusted works obediently.

Proverbs 12:24 says, “Hard work will give you power; being lazy will make you a slave”. Israelites when they realize their sinning life, and repent for their sins and turn to God, God showed mercy on them, blessed them and released them from slavery, and provided their belongings.

Isralites were commanded by God to show love towards foreigners (non-citizens) in their land. There is no discrimination of God between Isralites and other gentiles in their land. (See Leviticus 19:33-34). All people are equal before God, each nation has its uniqueness, since all are his creation. All are bound to live with honor, improve their talents given by God, and bring  glory to Him.

God himself entrusted power and responsibility between men, and some people are made as kings,  judges and authorities giving more and more talents. Apostle Paul in his letter written to Romans 13:1 says, “Every one must obey the State authorities, because no authority exists without God's permission, and the existing authorities have been out there by God.

He wrote to Ephesians 6:5, stating, “Slaves, obey your human masters with fear and trembling; and do it with a sincere heart,” just like Jesus Christ. In Ephesians 6:9, he warned the masters stating, “Masters behave in the same way towards your slaves and stop using threats, and remember that you and your slaves belong to the same master in heaven, who judges everyone by the same standard”.

Jesus answered to Pilate (in John 19:11), “You have authority over me only because it was given to you by God”. Although he was the beloved Son of God, Jesus himself prayed to God stating  “take this cup of suffering away from me, if you will”. Jesus showed himself as a model for us, to obey God's will. We can see that Jesus did all healings and miracles, only after he got the authority from God, and glorified God.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our loving Father, we understand that you are the creator and all powers and wealth are your gifts to us as per your plan and you never showed any discrimination between rich and poor and in between the rulers and the ruled. Give us wisdom to us to glorify you wherever we are kept. We pray in the name of Jesus christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: No discrimination between Israelite and gentile
meditation: Jesus healed and released a daughter of Abraham who suffered for more than 18 years from the devil. She was an Israelite. Jesus healed a servant of a centurion, one samaritan among 10 healed from cancer and many others, from gentiles. And there are so many from Israelites and gentiles.

Thus Jesus never showed any discrimination between Istaelites and gentiles. In John 4:42, we can see that Jesus used one samaritan (gentile) lady, to make all her villagers know and believe that Jesus was Messiah and he came to provide salvation to all humans.

We can see in the old testament, that  because of their unfaithfulness, the Isralites were made as slaves and captives in gentile lands, and some gentiles were also made as slaves and captives in the lands of Israel. Nineveh was the deadliest enemy country of Isralites, but God wanted to give a chance to those people  to repent for their sins.

God himself revealed through his prophets how to treat a gentile slave or captive in the land of Israelite. Leviticans 19:33-34 says, “Do not ill-treat foreigners who are living in your land. Treat them as you would a fellow-Israelite, and love them as  you love yourself”. In Numbers 15:16, it says, “You and they (gentiles) are alike in the Lord's sight, the same laws and regulations apply to you and to them”.

Human values, which are formed prior to 1500 A.D in the Bible, and followed up in other countries are taken to our Indian constitution with the intervention of our intellectuals. It is for us to safeguard and protect the human rights, without any discrimination. It is every citizen's duty and endeavor to support and encourage the legal and political formats which safeguards human rights.

Jesus pitied the crowd that followed him and provided food for five thousand and for four thousand people on another occasion. He gave life to the son of a widow in depression, though she did not ask to give life to her dead son. Jesus released a devil from a Canaanite lady, a gentile. He has done many miracle healings on Sabbath days, in spite of criticism from Pharisees, irrespective of Israelite or gentile.

Jesus questioned what is good, “to save a man's life or  to destroy it”. (see Mark 3:4). Thus the criticisers could not open their mouth against Jesus. Law preachers misinterpreted the Law, which says to keep Sabbath day as Holy. They felt that nobody should work on a Sabbath day but to take rest. They were not allowed to do even good things on a Sabbath day.

When the Roman soldiers came to Jesus to arrest, one of the followers of Jesus cut off an ear of one of the soldiers. Jesus stopped his followers  and healed the ear of the soldier instantly and sent him off. Jesus did not find fault with the soldier, since that person has just followed the earthly authority, Jesus pitied him and showed humanity and healed him.

Romans 2:9-11 says, “There will be suffering and pain for all those who do what is evil, for the Jews first and also for the Gentiles. But God will give glory, honor and peace to all who do what is good, to the Jews first  and also to the Gentiles. For God judges everyone by the same standard”.

Jesus never showed any type of discrimination between men,  but always glorified God, and healed the sick. He did all things as a model for us long back as two thousand years ago, and showed human values, which formed the basis for constitutions of the nations. It is for us now to protect and carefully maintain those human values for the safety and security of our future generations.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our wonderful Father and creator. You created the Universe and the earth. All the tribes in the Universe are your creation. You wanted all of us to know that you are the only God and giving heat light and rain to all of us without any discrimination.  Help us to understand your universal love and your mighty power. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Respect the authorities
meditation: A centurion, who has authority over 100 soldiers, told Jesus that he was also working under an authority and that if he says to go, one will go. He humbled before Jesus stating that he was not that great to invite Jesus to his house and therefore, requested to just  release a word to heal his servant, so that his servant gets healed.  Jesus taught us to respect authority.
Though Jesus and Peter do not come under the category of taxpayers to the Government, Jesus asked Peter to arrange to pay tax, as stated in the miracle of “A shekel from the mouth of a fish”.

At the same time Jesus advised to “pay the emperor what belongs to the emperor and pay God what belongs to God”. (see Mathews 22:21). Jesus said in John 18:36, “My kingdom does not belong to this world”. Jesus taught us to respect authority in this world.

God is almighty and all powerful. Those who believe in Him, can be his sons and daughters, means God's children. That is the authority given by God to be his children, and that nothing is impossible to His children also.

Jesus says in John 14:12, “I am telling you the truth: whoever believes in me will do what I do --  yes, he will do even greater things, because I am going to the Father.  This authority works on those who believe and follow Him, and it would not work for those who fail in faith.

Jesus said in John 10:18, “No one takes my life away from me. I give it on my own will, I have the right to give it up, and I have the right to take it back. This is what my Father has commanded me to do.” With the same authority, Jesus commanded the storm to calm down, walked on sea water and made Peter walk on sea water, and gave back life to many people who died.

There is no authority except that which is given by God. Daniel 2:21 says, God controls the times and seasons, he makes and unmakes the kings, it is he who gives wisdom and  understanding. All the earthly authorities are all God given.

In Spite of being the beloved son of God, Jesus honored the worldly authority and humbled himself till death by crucifixion, although he was son of God.  Jesus taught us to honor and respect the earthly authority.

God created the man to rule the creation, and he loved the man and gave him full freedom. Freedom was misused by man and led to sin, which further led to instability and no peace between men and also between the rulers and the ruled.

It is for the man himself to repent for his sins, leave the sins, keep away from the evil who encourages men to sin, and live as per God's wishes, then only the misuse of authorities can be eradicated. Whomsoever misuses his God given authority, is an enemy to God, and he will reap his fruit at the appropriate time. We should learn to respect authority.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, Thank you for teaching us through Jesus Christ,  to respect authorities, since all the authority to any one is given by you only. Help us to have such a mind, to respect others and to work for peace.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Transparency
meditation: Before healing a man with a paralyzed hand on a Sabbath day, Jesus put a question to the Pharisees and others, “What does our Law allow us to do on the Sabbath day, to help or to harm?, and then only Jesus healed, so that nobody can find a fault with him.

In the miracle of changing water to wine, Jesus did not touch the water, gave no scope to touch water or the pots. Jesus asked the workers to take some water in the pots to the incharge of the feast, and thus did the miracle transparently.
Though there is no need for Jesus to observe transparency in all the healings and miracles, He did everything transparently as a model for us. There is no magic, secret or anything like that.
By a simple word from his mouth, Jesus gave life to the dead, devils left, healed from sick, deaf could hear, dumb could speak, blind could see.

Even without saying anything about healing and by simply directing the ten dreaded skin deceased persons to show their bodies to the authorities of synagogue, all the ten got healed as they were proceeding to show their bodies to the concerned authorities.

In the healings done to the persons on a Sabbath day,  with paralyzed hand and to the person whose hands and legs are swollen, Jesus showed transparency by asking the pharisees and others around, before healing,  about what the Law says as “to help or to harm on a Sabbath day”

When Lazarus died, there was no need for Jesus to personally go to that village and give life to him. Jesus went to that place four days after the death of Lazarous, in order to show transparency before the public of that area, before the relatives and friends of Lazarus family, and his disciples. Jesus showed transparency in all the healings and miracles, in order to make the unbelievers and unfaithful persons, to know the truth. (see John 11:13).
Not only in healings, but in all walks of life, it is a very valid thing to follow transparency. Jesus taught us to be transparent in all our activities.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our Holy God,  Thank you for teaching us to be transparent in all walks of our life.  We pray to give us your wisdom and knowledge to deal with any one  fairly and frankly.  We pray in the name of Jesus christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Customs and conventions
meditation: Israelites while multiplying in Egypt lived as slaves for four hundred and thirty  years because of their unfaithful deeds. When they repented and prayed to God,  God pleased and released them from slavery through Moses and Aaron. After they walked through wilderness for forty years to reach Kanaan, the gifted place for them, they multiplied further. In order to make them live in the right way, God gave them ten commandments through Moses.

God gave the Isralites customs and conventions for their living and procedures for the cleaning from their sins. When all the twelve generations of Isralites started living as separate groups and kingdoms, some more changes were made in their customs and conventions.

One of the ten commandments is “observe the Sabbath day and keep it Holy”, since God created everything in six days and took rest on the seventh day and kept it Holy. The Sabbath day is meant to keep it Holy and to take rest from doing work for their life's earnings.

The Israelites interpreted the commandments for not doing any work (good or bad) and made it as custom and they opposed doing good and life saving works also. When Jesus healed some sick persons on Sabbath day, the Judas in those days found Jesus as a violation of custom and as an opponent of God's Law.

They have even gone to the extent of pleading to kill him on cross, in order to continue their authority in the name of Law and to protect their wealth and interests, this was the plan of the Pharisees and other authorities.

In the miracle and healing of a person called Mob from multiple devils, the people of the town showed interest in protecting their property (pigs as livestock) instead of relief from devils and healing (life saving) of a person, but  prayed Jesus to leave their town and from their place.

Customs and conventions are designed in the beginning to pave a way for a better living. Over a period of time when they were found to be against the good and righteousness, and found to create imbalance and intolerances among the people, they needed to be revised or removed altogether if necessary.

Many intellectuals found certain customs created inequities among people, they started creating awareness to remove such customs. Some people are unaware of the inequities and consequences of such customs but followed them to enable them for their daily bread. Some people oppose the customs in order to protect their business and power.

Such opposition to remove the wrong customs, prompted the Pharisees and Judas, to protect their power and properties,  to plot against Jesus for killing in the name of violation of customs and opposition of God's Law, by misleading the common persons and even misusing their power and money.

Many people agree that the human body gets decayed over a period of time but the spirit remains even after death.  But they showed less importance to spirituality and showed a lot of importance to their customs and conventions.

Customs and conventions  to some extent may be useful as worldly tools to control our body and mind. When human values are at stake, those customs and conventions need to change, by removing or modifying them.
Jesus asked which is right whether “to do good or bad and whether to save life or to kill”, on a Sabbath day. Nobody answered, because they had no answer.

Their minds became corrupt with wrong customs and conventions. Jesus healed a man with paralyzed hand on a Sabbath day. Jesus healed a blind beggar on a Sabbath day, who waited at Bethesda pond for about  thirty eight years. Jesus healed a sick person with swollen hands and legs on a Sabbath day.

God told Moses to say to the community of Israel, “Be Holy, because I, the Lord your God, am Holy”, see leviticus 9:2. Jesus expressed his anguish in Mathews 15:9 and Mark 7:6 & 7, as stated in Isaiah 29:13 “The Lord said, “these people claim to worship me, but their words are meaningless, and their hearts are  somewhere else”.

People of those days could not understand and also did not like the words of God, which are spiritual based. Any worship without being Holy and with wrong customs created by man, gets no answer from God. Spiritual Holiness is the base for Godliness.
Worldly people tend to ignore Spiritual Holiness but rely on unholy acts in the name of  customs and conventions and mislead people.

Jesus said in Mathews 10:28, “Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather be afraid of God, who can destroy both body and soul in hell”. Proverbs 20:27 says, “The Lord gave us mind and consciousness, we cannot hide from ourselves”.

Proverbs 21:3 says, “Do what is right and fair that pleases the Lord more than bringing the sacrifices”. It is a lesson for us to listen to the spirit, live a holy and righteous life, keeping away from wrong customs.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, thank you for teaching us to help rather than to hurt others in the name of customs and conventions and to follow righteousness and to be Holy.  Help us to follow you.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Repentance and keeping away from sins
meditation: Jesus healed a sick man brought down before him by opening tiles of a house, by forgiving his sins. After healing a blind and sick person at Bethesda pond, Jesus warned him stating  “Listen, you are well now, stop sinning or something worse may happen to you”. Jesus pitied the sick and healed them.

It is understood that by repentance and by leaving their sins, those people got relief from sin and they got healed. Jesus clearly told that if a healed person commits sin again, something worse will happen to them.

“When an evil goes out of a person, and if he keeps it vacant without the Holy Spirit, the evil spirit comes back with seven more evil spirits. Thus that person will be in a worse state than he was at the beginning. (See Matthews 12:43).

The people who got life by Jesus Christ, might have died again because their span of life was fixed (or extended to that extent)  by God. The healed persons might have gotten sick again, may be because of their sining habits.
That is why Jesus clearly said not to commit sin again. It is in our own interest that we should keep ourselves Holy and live for the glory of God, so that we can continue in His mercy.

Romans 8:5 says, “Those who live as their nature tells them to, have their minds controlled by what human nature wants. Those who live as the Spirit tells them to, have their control by what the Spirit wants. To be controlled by human nature results in death.  To be controlled by Spirit results in life and peace”.

James 1:15 says, “But a person is tempted when he is drawn away and trapped by his own evil desires. Then his evil desire conceives and gives birth to sin, and his sin when it is fully grown, gives birth to death”.
Romans 5:12 says, “Sin came into the world through one man, and his sin brought death with it. As a result,  death has spread to the whole human race because everyone has sinned”.
Jesus said in John 5:24, : I am telling you the truth, whoever hears my words and believes in him who sent me has eternal life. He will not be judged, but he has already passed from death to life”.

Sinless Christ took all the sins of humans on him, died on the cross and resurrected on the third day, as a Glorified Body, as prophesied, and won over death. We are to learn, to confess our sins, leave the sins, and live  with the Holy Spirit, to live a satisfactory and peaceful life.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, we understand  that confession, repentance and keeping away from sins makes our life peaceful and healthy. Help us to keep us away from sin and shield us from evil influences.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Be calm and be courageous
meditation: Jesus calmed down the wind and water in the sea and walked on sea waters. There Jesus told his disciples to “Not to fear, be calm and courageous”. Disciples of Jesus need not fear when Jesus himself was with them personally, who can order and control nature.

Yayir believed that it is enough if Jesus keeps His hand on his daughter who is going to die soon. Jesus might be aware in spirit  that Yayir’s daughter was dead. Meanwhile, a lady suffering from severe bleeding for 12 years was healed by touching the cloak of Jesus.

When Yayir received a message from his people that his daughter was dead, Jesus made him hear the witness of that healed lady, and strengthened his faith, and said to Yayir, “Don't be afraid, only believe”.

Human tendency is to say that a person helped like a God when they got an extraordinary help or favor from that person. Similarly a man feels like he is in a threat or danger, then also he fears. A man is always a man whether he faces a threat or out of a threat.  A man cannot be equalled with God, because  man was created by God.

In olden days, when there was no Godly awareness among the people, people used to fear the creation of God like, sun, moon, and other planets, stars, water, fire, air, earth, rocks, trees, and even snakes etc. This bad custom happened out of fear of those elements because they can harm, in olden days and treated as customary gods.

This type of lack of awareness was there even prior to Jesus Christ, but continued as such in the name of faith and customs. Some bad customs are abandoned, but still being continued and can be removed only by creating awareness. Creator is one only and he imparted some qualities and fixed certain rules for those objects created. He is God.

As seen in the old testament, God said, “Do not be afraid” to Abraham in Genesis 15:1, to Isaac in Genesis 26:24, to Jacob and the Isralites through Moses in Deuteronomy 20:3 and so many others on several occasions, and strengthened them.

“Be bold and strong'’ and “Do not fear” said Jesus on many occasions when healing the sick. Jesus said in Mathews 10:28, “Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul, rather be afraid of God, who can destroy both body and soul in  hell”. Jesus said that he came for the salvation of souls in Mathews chapter 10.

“I have not come to call respectable people, but outcasts”, said Jesus in Mathews 9:13 and in Luke 5:32. Respectable people means righteous people. And sinners are outcasts and they need salvation for their souls.

Jesus said in John 14:11 & 12, “Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me. If not, believe in the things that I do. I am telling the truth, whoever believes in me will do what I do  -- yes, he will do even greater things, because I am going to the Father”.

Because of the word “be calm and bold”  people can have peace and can understand God and hear the voice of God. Samuel was a boy serving prophet Eli. When God called Samuel, Samuel calmly heard the voice of God and responded to God  stating that he was listening. (see First Samuel 3:10). Thereafter Samuel did great things in God's direction.

Believers in God should be cool and calm in their mind. Ecclesiastes10:3 says, 'fools' stupidity will be evident even to strangers he meets along the way, he lets everyone know that he is a "fool”. If any one rectifies himself, he need not fear, he can be cool and calm and can be bold in his activities.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father and creator, thank you for teaching us to rest on you in our daily activities.  By human weakness we tend to fear on each and every trouble instead of being bold and courageous as said by you to us at several occasions in your Word. Help us to be strong in your faith. We pray in the name of Jesus christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Be in faith
meditation: In the miracle of changing water into wine, the workers believed and filled the rock pots with water and then waited for further instructions from Jesus. When Jesus asked the workers to take a bowl of the water to the man in-charge of the feast, they simply followed instructions without asking what happens since it is only water.

They did not expose their worldly knowledge, and did what Jesus said to them. They could see the miracle with their own eyes. When a problem strikes us, we wish that God has to solve it, but we try worldly solutions and fall into complications.

Faith of those friends, who brought down the sick person in front of Jesus by removing the tiles of the house, is very great. Faith of the centurion, faith of the Canaanite woman to get release of the devil caught  to her daughters, are all the results of holding faith.

Jesus and his disciples are proceeding  to Jairus’s house to heal the sickness of Jairus’s daughter. Before they went there, the daughter died. Jairus’s servants told Jairus not to trouble the teacher (Jesus) since his daughter was dead. But Jesus strengthened the faith of Jairus stating “Don't be afraid, only believe”.

At that time, Jesus let him hear the witness of a lady healed from blood bleeding disease for 12 years, by just touching the cloth of Jesus, and strengthened the faith of Jairus. Jesus told the healed lady, “My daughter,  your faith has made you well, go in peace, and be healed  of your trouble”. Thus Jesus made Jairus understand the importance of faith.
In the healing of a dumb person  from a devil, and while healing an epileptic person suffering from a devil, Jesus taught to have faith and prayer.

The blind man at Bethsaida, showed such a faith in Jesus, he did not hesitate to face excommunication from society. In the case of the blind man named Bartimaeus on a road side, he had his sight because of his faith. Jesus said to him, “Your faith has made you well”. (Mark 10:52).
After healing the sick on many occasions Jesus said, “Your faith has made you well”, “Be in peace”. Faith has to come up from the heart. Our body reacts based on the strength of our faith.

The Bible says that it is not only the body, but all creation reacts,  with the permission of God. As seen in Joshua 10:13, “The sun stood still in the middle of the sky and did not go down for a whole day”.

Exodus 14:22 says, “The water was divided, and the Isralites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on both sides”. In Ezekiel 37:4-10, dry bones began to join together, bones were covered with sinews and muscles and then with skin, and the dead bodies were brought back to life.

In Daniel 3:27, Shadrach, Meshech and Abednego came out of the fire, their hair was not burnt, their clothes were not burnt, and there was no smell of smoke on them. These instances clearly tell us that God can change the properties of creation.

Isaiah 28:16 says, “Faith that is firm is also patient”. Jesus said in Mathews 17:21, “I assure you that  if you have faith as big as a mustard seed, you can say to this hill, ‘Go from here to there’ and it will go. You could do anything" .

Jesus said in Matthews 21:22, “If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer”. About the people of Nazareth, Jesus further said in  Mathews 13:58, “Because they did not have faith, he did not perform miracles” (ie., at Nazareth).

In 2 Corinthians 6:14, Paul warned the Corinthians, “Do not try to work together as equals with unbelievers, for it cannot be done. How can right and wrong be partners? How can light and darkness live together?” It is a warning for us also.

Psalms 1:1 says,“Happy are those who reject the advice of evil men, who do not follow the example of sinners, or join those who have no use for God”. We are to follow that we should not be partners with unfaithful people, and we are to live with belief and faith in God.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, You taught us to keep faith in you. You helped to strengthen and increase our faith at times of difficulty.  Help us to be patient and strong enough to stay in your faith.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Life of Thanksgiving
meditation: In the miracle of giving life to Lazarus, Jesus prayed to Father stating, “I thank you Father that you listen to me”. Thereafter Jesus called Lazarus loudly to come out of the tomb.

In the miracle of feeding five thousand people, where there is no sufficient food to feed even one, Jesus took the bread from a little boy, gave thanks to God and thereafter  gave it to the disciples for distribution to more than five thousand men.
In the case of healing a dumb and deaf person, Jesus took him off from the crowd, lifted up his eyes to heaven and healed. Lifting up his eyes to heaven is to pray to God and for thanksgiving to God.
Jesus prayed to God and gave thanks to God, even before the miracle/healing took place. Jesus gave thanks to God before praying as if they were already given, as a model for us.
In Mark 11:24 Jesus said, “I tell you, when you pray and ask for something, believe that you have received it, and you will be given whatever you ask for”.

In the miracle of ten dreaded skin deceased persons, one of them was a samaritan, found himself getting healed and proceeding to show his body to the preachers along with the other 9, but he came back and gave thanks to Jesus in the first instance.

In the miracle of blind person on the roadside, when he heard that Jesus was calling him, before healing himself, he threw his cloth from him and came to Jesus. Throwing off his cloth before healing, is a sign of thanksgiving to Jesus with faith, as if he was healed and there is no need for his old clothes (rather old suffering).

Jesus touched a dreaded skin deceased person and healed. There Jesus  said to him, “Go straight to the priest and let him examine you, then in order to prove everyone that you are cured, offer the sacrifice that Moses ordered”. It was written that many of the cured persons from the deceased spread  the news everywhere.

In our day to day life, we used to say thanks and be thankful to those who helped us. God gave us life and protected us from all surrounding temptations, with love and pity on us. We are bound to be thankful at every stage and every time. Thanks giving means glorifying God.

Whomsoever healed are supposed to live thankfully to God.  Not only the healed, but also those relieved from problems and troubles, and those blessed in any manner are to immediately thank God by giving his  witness  and live thankfully to God. It is a lesson for us.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, You gave us life, protected us from all surrounding temptations with love and pity on us.  All the blessings are given by you only. What else we can give back to you, except giving our  wholehearted thanks and glorifying you.  Help us to keep ourselves in consciousness by your grace.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Positive thinking
meditation: When God regulated His creation, he also allowed changes to the regulations. When God created the human body, he allowed it to face changes and to bring to normalcy, when it was challenged by internal disturbances, for example to say “immunity”.

Similarly when earth has to change and adjust itself, earthquakes and blast of mountains with fire etc., will occur. Water and air, when it has to adjust itself, cyclones and tsunamis etc., will occur.

We may not be quite aware of the reasons for the infirmities of our body when born, we are sure to get into troubles, if we commit our bodies to sin, even with or without our knowledge, carelessly or due to unawareness. Without taking proper care of protecting our environment, we are sure to get health problems.

Similarly, if we pollute the earth, air and water, it will disturb the balancing factor of the environment, and thus we are dragging our environment and pave way to protect itself from imbalance, which may lead to severe consequences in the environment.
The same rectifying factor acts within our body or externally or on our minds. Thus good things will happen to those who keep themselves Holy, and bad to those of unholy.
Galatians 5:7 says, “A person will reap exactly what he sows”. “Your reward depends on what you say and what you do, you will get what you deserve”, says Proverbs 12:14.

Weakminded will get more fear. Faith overcomes fear, and by doing good things with faith we can win over fear. When we have good things in mind and do good things, it develops positive thinking in our minds.

If faith in God adds to those who think positively, it can be a fruitful life. Jesus said in Matthew 25:29, “For every person who has something, even more will be given, and he will have more than enough; but the person who has nothing, even the little that he has will be taken away from him”.
The word of Jesus leads us to understand the impact of positive thinking in our attitude and in our works. It also makes us understand how greatly we may suffer if we don't have a positive attitude.

After knowing that his daughter was dead, Jairus  should have gone back, losing hope. Peter would have gone back, when he was asked by Jesus to go fishing, since he failed in fishing last night. In the case of a kanaan lady praying to heal her daughter, she should have gone back when Jesus himself discouraged testing her faith.
In many such occasions, in spite of discouraging circumstances, they had shown their positive attitude and got good results. Negative attitude results in loss and bad.

Positive attitude increases faith and success. Without wasting our time in negative thoughts, we are supposed to do our work in faith, so that we can succeed in all our walks of life, socially, physically and mentally. God will strengthen us in all our needs.
“The God of all grace, who calls you to share his eternal glory in  union with Christ, will himself perfect you and give you firmness, strength, and a sure foundation” says 1 Peter 5:10.

Those seeking healing will have to wait with faith and a positive attitude. When Jesus entered the house of Jairus to give life to his daughter, Jesus sent out the crying people, and then gave life to the dead. Crying is an indication of a faithless attitude and those of a negative attitude. We are to learn that a positive attitude is a step to increase our faith.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our loving father, You are the creator and regulator of all.  Help us to properly maintain all that you have given to us to enjoy and rule over your creation.  Help us to be always in your consciousness, that  faith in you and following you,  only can give us a peaceful life.  Help us to be a positive thinker despite all our negative thoughts of evil spirits.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Strengthening human efforts
meditation: In the miracle of changing water to wine, the workers need not fill the pots with water. In spite of failure in fishing the previous night, Peter started fishing afresh on the word of Jesus, and Jesus made Peter’s human effort successful with abundant catch.
For feeding about five thousand men, and on another occasion to feed four thousand people, Jesus need not have fish and bread of some person in his hand.

For healing, the blind person need not go all the way to the pool of Siloam  to wash. In certain cases, Jesus wanted to do miracles with human intervention and human effort. We are bound to obey the will of God. The healing of Naaman suffering from dreaded skin disease, in the old testament, is similar. (See 2 kings chapter 5)

When God created man, he blessed us to have children (descendants), live all over the earth, and to have control on His creation. Whatever talents God has given to us, we are to strive and improve them, but not like the one who buried the talents under earth. (See Mathews 25).

It is our responsibility to properly utilize all the facilities (talents) that God provided us. In that process, God will bless us and make us fruitful, provided we are attached to God, which means to reject unholy things and follow the things acceptable to God. “To honor the Lord is to hate evil”, says proverbs 8:13.

Without reading and  understanding the subject, the students will not get good results. In our jobs and business activities, we cannot get good results without making sincere efforts. We cannot keep ourselves healthy without protecting ourselves from infections and maintain hygiene ness.
Without sincerity, we cannot expect proper cooperation from spouse, family members, neighbors and in our Society. Without prayer, we cannot expect spiritual help from God and salvation.
As we obey our authorities, we are to fulfill our duties and responsibilities, in our day to day life, in our families, churches and in Society, sincerely and transparently.

We are expected to make use of all the God given talents and opportunities, sincerely and honestly without laziness and negligence,  and live with hope and faith, God will bless and make us fruitful. “If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer”, Jesus said in  Mathews 21;22.

In the old testament, Isralites had done so many wars in order to occupy their promised land. They won all the wars where they first approached God through prayer. Those wars helped them to get strength bodily and mentally, and also to live in faith and in fear of God.
Naaman, a non-Isralite was healed when he strictly followed instructions of the prophet of God.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father, you taught us to make our all out efforts faithfully and sincerely, keeping away from laziness and negligence, while putting all of our good activities through prayer.  Help us to strengthen our body and mind, always to look at you and to be responsible to properly utilize your gifts for your glory.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Glorify God
meditation: The Evil Spirit in the man after seeing Jesus, glorified God saying, “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Are you here to destroy us?  I know who you are  -- You are God's Holy messenger”, (Mark 1:23-28).

After healing from the dreaded skin disease, the man glorified God, by witnessing to so many people. (Mark 1:40-45). After healing from several demons, the man (Mob)  went all through the ten towns telling what Jesus had done for him, and thus glorified God. (Mark 5:1-20)

Two men came out from the burial caves, after healing, glorified God as “Son of God” in their town, (Mathew 8:28-34). Two blind men, after getting sight, glorified God, by spreading this news  all over that part of the country. (Mathews 9:27-31).
In the case of Jesus giving life to a widow's son, that news went out through all the country, and the surrounding territory. (Luke 7:11-16).
In the case of Lazarus brought to life, Jesus said “You would see God's glory if you believed”. The four days delay in bringing life to Lazarous has happened to bring glory to God. (John 11:3-44).
Jesus  did all the miracles, such as feeding 5000 and 4000 people, with practically nothing in his hand,  all done  to glorify God.

In our day to day life, we give thanks to those who  helped us, even in small issues. God has given us life, health, wealth and protected us from many unexpected troubles. How much we are to give thanks to such a great God.
Thanks giving means glorifying God. Jesus himself glorified God and showed as a role model for us, which we are to learn and follow Jesus.
thematic_lessons.prayer: Our gracious Father in heaven, thank you for the life, health, wealth and protection from unexpected troubles in our life.  Give us a mind to glorify you for  all our gifts and  by offering thanksgiving, and keep faith in you.  We pray in the name of Jesus Christ.  Amen.

thematic_lessons.title: Surrendering to God's will
meditation: A dreaded skin diseased person approached Jesus and begged, “Sir, if you want to, you can make me clean”. Jesus said in Luke 5:13,  “I do want to” and said “Be clean”. He was clean on the spot. Though he wanted to be clean from the disease, he preferred to give importance to the will of Jesus and said “if you want to”.

The dreaded skin diseased person might have realized that the said disease came to him on account of his sins, and that he may not be fit enough to be pardoned.  Jesus knows the thoughts of men, and therefore healed him from his disease.

One of the thieves crucified along with Jesus said, in Luke 23:42, “Remember me Jesus, when you come as king”. He did not ask Jesus to pardon him, or to forgive  his sins or to give him eternal life etc.

The thief who believed Jesus at the time of crucification itself that Jesus was the Son of God, and he will come back as king in his kingdom. He simply asked to remember him. He might have feared that he was an unpardonable sinner, and showed his humble and surrendering mind.
Jesus said to him, “I promise you that today you will be  in Paradise with me”. Jesus will provide salvation and the same promise that was given to the thief, to those who pray Him wholeheartedly.

Jesus knows that he was to be crucified shortly. As a normal human being and as he knows his physical weakness, he prayed to God, “My Father,  if it is possible, take this cup of suffering from me.  Yet not what I want, but what you want.”

God's plan was to provide salvation to the entire world, through the crucifixion of the Son of God. The objective of Jesus was to fulfill the plan of God, and it was God's wish. Thus Jesus surrendered himself to God’s will.
