Daniel was prepared to be thrown into the lion's den. God closed the mouths of those lions. Shedrach, Meshech and Abednego are prepared themselves to be thrown into fire. They expressed that they don't bow down before other Gods, even if God does not save them from fire. But God saved them from fire and not even one of their hairs was burnt. It was God's will.

After 40 days of fasting  prayer, Jesus himself had to face the temptations from Satan. In our day to day life we are to naturally face temptations from Satan. Jesus taught his disciples how to pray to God, where they were asked to pray to God, “ Do not bring  us to hard testing, but keep us safe from the Evil one” (Mathews 6:13).

1 Corinthians 10:13 says, “God keep his promise, and he will not allow you to be tested beyond your power  to remain firm, at the same time you are put to the test, he will give you the strength to endure it, and so provide you with a way out”.
We cannot avoid temptations, but we pray to God to strengthen us to face and win over the temptations. It is a lesson to be learnt by us.
19. A small analysis on the meditation
(On the  lessons on miracles and healings done by Jesus Christ.)

Not only in miracles and healings, Jesus learnt us many human values and spiritual values in the sermon on the mount, in revealing the parables taught to disciples and many others about kingdom of God, in his prayers to God on behalf of disciples and others on several occasions and in the seven words on the cross, etc.
While God had shown miracles and healings through prophets in the old testament days, the miracles and healings done by Jesus were written in the Gospels according to Mathews, Mark, Luke and John.

In John 14:12, Jesus said, “whoever believes in me will do what I do - Yes he will do even greater things”. The apostles and disciples have done miracles and healings after Jesus and were written in the books and letters written by them to the churches.

Jesus did healings very transparently to those who approached him.  Jesus said in Mathews 10:8, ”Heal the sick, bring the dead back to life, heal those who suffer from dreaded skin diseases, and drive out demons. You have received without paying, so give without being paid”.

All healings are free of cost by the grace of God, and without any financial dealings or in the name of offerings etc. Any promised healing with offering (with compulsion or conditions) or money dealings are not  for the glory of God.

Those who claim money or favor or promise for healing are not with the approval of God.  Those who seek healing  by faith should be able to discriminate against the money mongers. Money mongers will reap their fruit.

When Jesus healed, Jesus saw the acute desire of the sick, and that such a person has to repent for his sin and leave his sin. He should be honest and faithful and finally the miracle should result in the glory of God.

God knows the thoughts and secrets of every heart, and everything is open to God. However in order to strengthen our faith, Jesus said on many occasions “Do not fear or doubt” and “your faith has healed you”.

In some cases,  healings are delayed. The blind man at Bethesda waited years together for healing. Jesus said in another case of healing that neither he nor his parents are  responsible for his blindness but it was for the glory of God.

It took four days to get life for the dead Lazarus, though he and his family are very close friends to Jesus. Such cases are meant for the glory of God. Jesus clarified that this delay was meant for the glory of God.

Some people try to get favor from God, by walking in fire,  by kneeling down in red hot sand. Such acts may result in getting some sort of recognition among people or expecting some sympathy from God. It is impossible to get sympathy from God by straining our bodies. But God looks at our mind.

Jesus said in  Mark 12:33, “It is more important to obey these two commandments than to offer animals and other sacrifices to God”. There is only one way to get favor from God, that is to follow His commandments with honesty and live with faith”.

God knows all our needs. In Matthews 6:33 and in  Luke 12: 29-31, it is said, “So don't be all upset, always concerned about what you will eat and drink. Your Father knows that you need these things. Instead be concerned  with His kingdom and he will provide you with these things”. If we live, with faith and honesty and a righteous life, God will hear our prayers and fulfill according to His riches.

In the old testament we can see that Satan has also done some miracles, but they are all overridden by the miracles done by God's prophets. Such miracles are done at the time of  Moses  in the kingdom of Pharaoh. But those miracles could not stand before the  miracles done by prophets of God.

In Mathews 24:24, Jesus said, “false Messiahs and false prophets will appear, they will perform great miracles and wonders in order to deceive even God's chosen people, if possible”. Jesus told this before it happened, to beware of such lying and misleading prophets misusing  the name of Jesus. It is not that easy to identify such wrong doers.

We are to remember the words of Jesus in Mathews 10:16, “You must be as cautious as  snakes and as gentle as doves”. Jesus taught us to be cautious as snakes and as gentle as doves, live with honesty and sincerity, and cautious as snakes and not to get misled by Satan.

In the case of healings, Satan tries to exploit human weaknesses. Satan tried to exploit Jesus as a human and asked Jesus to turn stones into bread, when Jesus completed fasting for 40 days and feeling hungry. Then Jesus replied through the word of God stating, “Man cannot live on bread alone”.

It is for us to see whether the temptation is to exploit our weakness. We should not forget whether we are testing our God. As a faithful believer in God, we are not supposed to test our God (see Luke 4:12).

When the disciples felt happy about the miracles they are doing in the name of God, Jesus said in Mark 16:17, and also in Luke 10:19 & 20, “Don't be glad because the evil spirits obey you, rather be glad because your names are written in heaven”.

Healings to our bodies are not permanent, but they are subject to the limitations of nature created by God. But the healings related to the Spirit are subject to our mind such as repentance and leave the sinful acts completely, have faithfulness and belief in God, live righteously and follow commandments. Sin leads to sickness and finally to death.

It is said in John 6:63, “What gives life is God's spirit, man's power is of no use at all”. Isaiah 62:11 says, “The Lord is announcing to all the earth, the Lord is coming to save you, bringing with him the people he has rescued”. Paul the Apostle said, “So I run straight towards the goal in order to win the prize, which is God's call through Jesus Christ to the life above”.
The sacrifice of Jesus on Calvary for our salvation  is the greatest wonderful  miracle and uncomparable, not only to the Isralites but to all mankind. Salvation is to our souls for eternal life.

Bible revealed that those who already experienced healings and miracles and that those who are yet to experience are supposed to lead a life with fear and honor to God, with honesty and sincerity, with truth and faith, and follow his commands to love God and love one another, and keeping ourselves away from the lust and worldly temptations.

Jesus said in Mathews 6:33, “ So do not start worrying, ‘where will my food come from? Or my drink or my clothes . . . . .instead be concerned above everything else with the  kingdom of God and with what  He required of you, and He will provide you with all those other things”.
The act of helping human in need was highlighted and practically done by Jesus, treating such help as if it was done to God. (see Mathews 25:40).  Jesus stood as a model for us to follow.

Luke 2:14 says, “Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to those with whom He is pleased”. God is gracious towards those who seek Him and follow Him. He will lead us in His grace. Amen.
